titleZh: 千手千眼观世音菩萨广大圆满无碍大悲心陀罗尼（大悲咒84句全本）
titleEnglish: Great Compassion Dhāraṇī of Ārya Avalokiteśvara (Complete 84 Clauses)
sutraSourceZh: 《千手千眼觀世音菩薩廣大圓滿無礙大悲心陀羅尼經》(T20n1060)
deityZh: 千手千眼圣观自在菩萨 (Sahasrabhuja-sahasranetra Āryāvalokiteśvara / Nīlakaṇṭha)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 汉传与唐密最为核心的根本大咒，通行本共 84 句完整单列、逐句对齐无合并。本词条直接接入下载自 CBETA 官方库之《T20n1113B》334个悉昙梵字与汉字逐字对音数据，以及《T20n1064》唐代不空三藏译本之全部八十四句本尊化身夹注，全咒由初段三宝观音归敬（第1–17句）、根本心咒（第18–52句）、十大成就化身礼赞（第53–75句）及三宝满愿结归（第76–84句）组成。
recitationTipsZh: 持诵时注意 r 音（如 ratna, trayāya, kāruṇikāya）需舌尖轻弹上颚（唐代注「转舌呼」）；长元音 ā, ī, ū, e, o 均属重音（Guru，2拍），短元音 a, i, u 属轻音（Laghu，1拍），八十四句句读清晰、轻重分明则梵音自然庄严流畅。

「南無喝囉怛娜哆囉夜㖿此是觀世音菩薩本身，大須慈悲用心讀誦，勿 高聲神性急[一] 南無阿唎㖿[此是如意輪菩薩本身，到此須存心][二] 婆盧羯 帝爍鉢囉㖿[此是持鉢觀世音菩薩本身，若欲取舍利骨，誦此存想菩薩持鉢][三] 菩 提薩埵婆㖿[此是不空羂索菩薩，押大兵][四] 摩訶薩埵婆㖿此是菩薩 種子自誦呪之本身也[五] 摩訶迦盧尼迦㖿此是馬鳴菩薩本身，手把鈸折羅 即是[六] 唵[此唵是諸鬼神合掌聽誦呪也][七] 薩皤囉罰曳此四大天王之本身，降 魔[八] 數怛那怛寫[此是四大天王部落鬼神名字也][九] 南無悉吉栗 埵伊蒙阿唎㖿[此是龍樹菩薩本身，大須用心誦此，勿疎失，菩薩性急][十] 婆盧吉 帝室佛羅㘄馱婆[此是圓滿報身盧舍那佛][十一] 南無那囉謹 墀[此是清淨法身毘盧遮那佛本身，大須用心][十二] 醯唎摩訶皤哆沙咩羊鳴， 此是羊頭神王，共諸天魔為眷屬[十三] 薩婆阿他豆輸朋此是甘露菩薩，亦是觀 世音菩薩部落以為眷屬也[十四] 阿逝孕[此是飛騰夜叉天王，巡歷四方察其是非也][十五] 薩婆 薩哆那摩婆伽[此是婆加帝神王，其形黑大，以豹皮為裩，手把鐵刃][十六] 摩罰 恃豆[此是軍吒利菩薩本身，把鐵輪并把索，而有三眼是也][十七] 怛姪他[此是劍語]十 八 唵阿婆盧醯[十九] 盧迦帝[此是大梵天王本身也，神仙為部落][二十] 迦羅帝[此是帝神長大黑色也][二十一] 夷醯唎此是三十三天，是摩醯首羅天神領天 兵，青色[二十二] 摩訶菩提薩埵[此是實心，更無雜亂心即名薩埵][二十三] 薩 婆薩婆[此是香積菩薩，押五方鬼兵以為侍從不可思議][二十四] 摩羅摩羅此是菩薩 相罰語，即為齊也[二十五] 摩醯摩醯唎馱孕[同前][二十六] 俱盧俱盧 羯懞[此是空身菩薩，押天大將軍，領二十萬億天兵也][二十七] 度盧度盧罰闍 耶帝[此是嚴峻菩薩，押孔雀王蠻兵也][二十八] 摩訶罰闍耶帝[同前][二十九] 陀羅陀羅[此是觀世音菩薩大丈夫身即是也][三十] 地唎尼此是師子王，兵驗 讀誦[三十一] 室佛羅娜[此是霹靂菩薩，降伏諸魔眷屬][三十二] 遮囉遮囉 [此是摧碎菩薩本身，手把金輪][三十三] 摩摩[某甲受持]罰摩囉此是大降魔金剛本身，把金 輪[三十四] 穆帝𭌚[此是諸佛合掌聽誦真言][三十五] 伊醯伊醯[此是魔醯首羅天王] [三十六] 室那室那[同前][三十七] 阿囉嘇佛囉舍利此是觀世音菩薩， 把脾弩弓箭也[三十八] 罰沙罰嘇[同前][三十九] 佛囉舍耶此是阿彌陀佛 本身，觀世音菩薩師主[四十] 呼盧呼盧摩羅[此是八部鬼神王][四十一] 呼盧 呼盧醯唎[同前][四十二] 娑囉娑囉[此是五濁惡世也][四十三] 悉唎悉 唎[此是觀世音菩薩，利益一切眾生不可思議][四十四] 蘇嚧蘇嚧此是諸佛樹葉落□ [四十五] 菩提夜菩提夜[此是觀世音菩薩結緣眾生][四十六] 菩馱夜菩 馱夜[此是阿難本身也][四十七] 彌帝唎夜[此是大車菩薩，手把金刀][四十八] 那 囉謹墀[此是龍樹菩薩手把金刀之處][四十九] 地唎瑟尼那此是寶幢菩薩，手持鐵叉 是也[五十] 波夜摩那此是寶金光幢菩薩，鉢折羅杵[五十一] 娑婆訶[去聲]五十 二 悉陀夜[此是達一切法門][五十三] 娑婆訶[去聲][五十四] 摩訶悉陀 夜[此是放光菩薩，手把赤幡][五十五] 娑婆訶[去聲][五十六] 悉陀喻藝此諸天菩薩盡 悉以集，手把金刀[五十七] 室皤囉夜[是安息香也][五十八] 娑婆訶[去聲]五十 九 那羅謹墀山海惠菩薩本身，手把金劍[六十] 娑婆訶[去聲][六十一] 摩 羅那羅此是寶即王菩薩，手把金斧[六十二] 娑婆訶[去聲][六十三] 悉囉僧 阿穆佉耶[此是藥王菩薩本身，行療諸病][六十四] 娑婆訶[去聲][六十五] 娑 婆摩訶阿悉陀㖿[此是藥上菩薩本身，行療諸病][六十六] 娑婆訶 [去聲][六十七] 者吉囉阿悉陀夜[同聲][六十八] 娑婆訶[去聲][六十九] 波 陀摩羯悉哆夜[同聲][七十] 娑婆訶[去聲][七十一] 那囉謹墀 皤伽囉㖿[七十二] 娑婆訶[七十三] 摩婆利勝羯囉夜七十 四 娑婆訶[七十五] 南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜耶[七十六] 南 無阿唎㖿[七十七] 婆盧吉帝[七十八] 爍皤囉夜[七十九] 娑 婆訶[八十] 悉殿都[八十一] 漫哆羅[八十二] 跋馱耶[八十三] 娑婆訶[八十四]」

verses.meaningZh: 归命佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜㖿

verses.meaningZh: 归命圣尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Noble One!

verses.meaningZh: 观自在尊（普观世间音声而自在拔苦者）！
verses.meaningEn: To Avalokiteśvara (the Sovereign Lord Who Gazes Upon the World)!

verses.meaningZh: 觉有情菩萨！
verses.meaningEn: To the Bodhisattva (Awakening Being)!

verses.meaningZh: 大勇猛有情摩诃萨！
verses.meaningEn: To the Mahāsattva (Great Heroic Being)!

verses.meaningZh: 具足无缘大慈同体大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: To the Greatly Compassionate One!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（法报化三身总持圣音，诸部鬼神合掌恭听）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 于一切怖畏危难中作自在救护尊！
verses.meaningEn: Sovereign Protector in all fears and perils!

verses.meaningZh: 向妙善施护救度尊致敬！
verses.meaningEn: Of the Pure Boon-Granting Savior!

verses.meaningZh: 我今顶礼如是圣尊已！
verses.meaningEn: Having bowed in homage to this Noble One!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南無悉吉利埵伊蒙阿唎㖿

verses.meaningZh: 圣观自在菩萨威光所充满之普陀净土法界！
verses.meaningEn: Pervaded by Avalokiteśvara at Potalaka!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 婆盧吉帝室佛囉㘄馱婆

verses.meaningZh: 归命青颈大悲尊（代众生吞咽烦恼毒药之悲愿相）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Nīlakaṇṭha (the Blue-Necked Compassionate Lord)!

verses.meaningZh: 我今宣说称诵此大悲广大心印陀罗尼！
verses.meaningEn: I shall now recite and revolve this Great Heart Dhāraṇī!

verses.meaningZh: 能圆满成就一切利乐妙善吉祥事业！
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciously accomplishing all noble aims!

verses.meaningZh: 无能胜、一切魔障烦恼所不能坏！
verses.meaningEn: Invincible and unconquerable!

verses.meaningZh: 普令一切众生归敬离垢、超越三有生死流转！
verses.meaningEn: Purifying all beings and transcending the realms of existence!

verses.meaningZh: 涤除一切疑惑罪垢令得清净！
verses.meaningEn: Cleansing away all stains and doubts!

verses.meaningZh: 即说根本心咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Namely, the Root Mantra is as follows:

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大悲慧眼遍观世间者！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O All-Beholding One!

verses.meaningZh: 超越世间生死苦海尊！
verses.meaningEn: Transcending the mundane world!

verses.meaningZh: 悲智双运超脱自在尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Transcendent Savior!

verses.meaningZh: 善来、狮子王无畏救苦尊！
verses.meaningEn: Come forth, O Lion-Lord Hari!

verses.meaningZh: 大菩萨摩诃萨！
verses.meaningEn: O Great Bodhisattva!

verses.meaningZh: 愿大悲速疾降临、普门游行救度！
verses.meaningEn: Proceed swiftly, glide forth in compassion!

verses.meaningZh: 请忆念、忆念本昔慈悲誓愿！
verses.meaningEn: Remember, remember Your primal vow!

verses.meaningZh: 请忆念护持我此大悲真言心印！
verses.meaningEn: Uphold my sacred heart-mantra!

verses.meaningZh: 速疾作法、速疾成办息增怀诛一切善妙佛事！
verses.meaningEn: Perform, accomplish the sacred enlightened activity!

verses.meaningZh: 坚固任持、坚固总持，得大尊胜自在！
verses.meaningEn: Hold fast, sustain, O Victorious One!

verses.meaningZh: 得最上广大无碍大尊胜！
verses.meaningEn: O Supremely Victorious One!

verses.meaningZh: 愿总持摄受、恒常执持不舍！
verses.meaningEn: Uphold, sustain all beings!

verses.meaningZh: 任持大地一切众生之总持王！
verses.meaningEn: O Earth-Sustaining Dhāraṇī Sovereign!

verses.meaningZh: 光耀大自在法王尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Radiant Sovereign Lord!

verses.meaningZh: 起大悲妙用、震动十方救苦！
verses.meaningEn: Move forth, stir into compassionate action!

verses.meaningZh: 令我身心离诸尘垢、彻底清净无染！
verses.meaningEn: Render me stainless and immaculate!

verses.meaningZh: 显现无垢清净解脱法身妙相尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Stainless Liberated Form!

verses.meaningZh: 善来、善来！唯愿圣尊速疾光临坛场！
verses.meaningEn: Come, come hither in grace!

verses.meaningZh: 斩断、斩断一切无明黑蛇毒害！
verses.meaningEn: Sever, cut away all venomous afflictions!

verses.meaningZh: 圣法王转大法轮，震落一切贪嗔痴毒！
verses.meaningEn: Advancing the Noble Dharma-Realm!

verses.meaningZh: 销融一切内外烦恼恶毒！
verses.meaningEn: Neutralizing poison upon poison!

verses.meaningZh: 彻底消灭一切罪障苦毒！
verses.meaningEn: Destroy and eradicate all afflictions!

verses.meaningZh: 速疾作法、速疾救度，大勇猛力士尊！
verses.meaningEn: Hasten, hasten, O Mighty Hero!

verses.meaningZh: 速疾救护、速疾拔苦，狮子无畏尊！
verses.meaningEn: Hasten, hasten, O Lion-Lord Hari!

verses.meaningZh: 坚固精髓、遍流法水润泽群生！
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth, stream everywhere!

verses.meaningZh: 大吉祥瑞光遍洒一切有情！
verses.meaningEn: Pour forth auspicious blessings!

verses.meaningZh: 甘露法乳涓涓流注身心！
verses.meaningEn: Trickle forth sweet ambrosial nectar!

verses.meaningZh: 觉悟、觉悟自性菩提妙心！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken, awaken to Enlightenment!

verses.meaningZh: 开晓、觉他，令一切众生速证圆觉！
verses.meaningEn: Enlighten, cause all beings to awaken!

verses.meaningZh: 大慈悲心尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Merciful One of Boundless Loving-Kindness!

verses.meaningZh: 青颈大悲观自在尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Blue-Necked Compassionate Nīlakaṇṭha!

verses.meaningZh: 愿以清净慈眼照见摄受！
verses.meaningEn: By Your merciful vision and gaze!

verses.meaningZh: 令见闻众生心生大清凉欢喜尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the One Who Brings Supreme Joy and Relief!

verses.meaningZh: 吉祥圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (May auspiciousness be accomplished)!

verses.meaningZh: 向成就一切悉地妙果尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Accomplished Siddha!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向大成就无上悉地尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Greatly Accomplished Mahāsiddha!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 于成就无上大悲瑜伽三摩地中！
verses.meaningEn: In the Yoga of Supreme Siddhi!

verses.meaningZh: 得大自在王尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Sovereign Lord of Siddha-Yoga!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向青颈大悲救苦尊！
verses.meaningEn: To Nīlakaṇṭha!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向猪面金刚（勇猛除障化身）尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Boar-Faced Wrathful Protector!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向人狮面无畏威德化身尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Man-Lion-Faced Fearless One (Narasiṃhamukha)!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向普摄一切广大殊胜成就尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the All-Encompassing Great Siddha (Sarvamahāsiddha)!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向手执金刚宝轮成就尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Wheel-Wielding Siddha (Cakrasiddha)!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向手执清净红莲华开敷本心尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Lotus-in-Hand One (Padmahasta)!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向青颈威猛伏魔尊！
verses.meaningEn: To Fierce Tiger-Clad Nīlakaṇṭha!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 向大勇力兴作一切吉祥安乐尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Mighty Beneficent Śaṅkara!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 再申归命十方常住三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage again to the Three Jewels!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜耶

verses.meaningZh: 归命圣尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Noble One!

verses.meaningZh: 普门慈眼垂视众生尊！
verses.meaningEn: O All-Gazing Avalokita!

verses.meaningZh: 神通圆融大自在王！
verses.meaningEn: Sovereign Lord Īśvara!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！唯愿一切善愿悉皆圆满成就！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! May they all be fully accomplished!
verses.tangNoteZh: 第八十一句 · 《T20n1064》单列第81句，祈愿成就印。

verses.meaningZh: 此大悲无碍真言神咒！
verses.meaningEn: The sacred Mantra!
verses.tangNoteZh: 第八十二句 · 《T20n1064》单列第82句，总持真言体。

verses.meaningZh: 一切秘密章句法门！
verses.meaningEn: Every Mantra-phrase and syllable!

verses.meaningZh: 决定吉祥圆满究竟成就，娑婆诃（八十四句全咒圆满）！
verses.meaningEn: Perfectly Accomplished in Auspiciousness, Svāhā!

titleZh: 佛顶尊胜陀罗尼（唐·不空译 35句悉昙梵汉对音注义全本）
titleEnglish: Uṣṇīṣavijaya Dhāraṇī (Complete 35 Clauses, Purifier of All Evil Destinies)
sutraSourceZh: 《尊勝佛頂脩瑜伽法軌儀》(T19n0973)
deityZh: 尊胜佛顶如来 / 佛顶尊胜佛母 (Uṣṇīṣavijayā)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 唐密与汉传最具代表性的净除一切恶道、增寿吉祥大陀罗尼，通行全本共 35 句完整逐句校勘。本词条直接接入从 CBETA 官方库下载之《T19n0974B》全部 470 个悉昙梵字与汉字逐字对音字元、不空三藏十门科判原典释义夹注，以及《T19n0974E》所附《学念梵音法》。
recitationTipsZh: 依据《T19n0974E·学念梵音法》原典训示：「夫诵陀罗尼，务存梵音。所有口边字者（如㗚、㘑、㘕），皆须弹舌而言之。侧注引者，长引其声（即梵文重长音 Guru）；所注二合者，两字相和，一时急呼（即梵文复辅音结合字）。」

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA XML-P5 T19n0973《尊勝佛頂脩瑜伽法軌儀》（唐 善無畏譯）
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh:
汉字咒文逐字取自 CBETA T19n0973《尊勝佛頂脩瑜伽法軌儀》原文（代码比对定位，与整理稿吻合 60%）。整理稿原标出处：T19n0967 / T19n0974B / T19n0974E 《佛顶尊胜陀罗尼经》(T19n0967) 暨《佛顶尊胜陀罗尼注义》(T19n0974B)。梵文转写在已收梵文原典（GRETIL）中未检得，为整理者参考转写。
已从 github.com/cbeta-org/xml-p5 下载 T19n0974B.xml、T19n0974E.xml 与 T19n0967.xml，按十门三十五句逐句独立建档并将释义夹注归入专栏。

cbetaInterlinearTokens.tangMeaningGloss: 世尊。已上第一歸敬尊德門
三身無見頂相義。已上第二影表法身門
自然清淨。已上第三淨除惡趣門
唯願攝受，攝受攝受，又三遍攘勝諸苦惱
堅住持壽命。已上第四善明灌頂門
一切障清淨也。所謂業障報障煩惱障也，得清淨云云。已上第五神力加持門
世寶，亦云法寶，所謂福惠二種資糧。已上第六壽命增長門
最勝最勝，即是真俗二諦法門
念持定惠相應。已上第七定惠相應門
是我之義，自稱姓名。為他人即稱他姓名。已上第八金剛供養門
一切如來安慰令得加持
能令覺悟，能令有情速得覺悟
大印，所謂如來大印。已上第九普證清淨門
吉祥之句。又云成就之義。已上第十成就涅槃門

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 于欲界、色界、无色界三界中最极殊胜超绝者！
verses.meaningEn: Pre-eminent and supreme throughout the three worlds!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛賴 路 枳也 鉢羅 底尾始瑟吒野

verses.meaningZh: 大觉佛陀、薄伽梵世尊！
verses.meaningEn: To the Awakened Buddha, the Blessed Lord!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沒馱 野婆 誐嚩帝

verses.meaningZh: 所谓即说真言曰：
verses.meaningEn: Namely, the Dhāraṇī is as follows:

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（法报化三身无见顶相总持法音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 请净除、彻底净除一切恶业重障！
verses.meaningEn: Purify, thoroughly purify!
verses.tangNoteZh: 第三门【净除恶趣门】第6句 · 夹注：「清净」。

verses.meaningZh: 无等伦且与十方诸佛普遍平等尊！
verses.meaningEn: Unequalled and equal to the unequalled!
verses.tangNoteZh: 第三门第7句 · 无等等法界平等智。

verses.meaningZh: 普放无量光明周遍照耀舒展于法界！
verses.meaningEn: Radiating all-pervading light everywhere!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三 滿跢 縛婆 娑娑頗 羅拏

verses.meaningZh: 照破六道生死稠林而自性本来清净无染尊！
verses.meaningEn: Pure in intrinsic nature amidst the dense paths of rebirth!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 誐底誐賀曩娑嚩 婆 嚩尾秫第

verses.meaningZh: 唯愿慈悲以甘露法水灌我顶门！
verses.meaningEn: Consecrate and anoint me!

verses.meaningZh: 善逝如来最上殊胜微妙言教！
verses.meaningEn: With the supreme words of the Sugata!

verses.meaningZh: 以不死甘露灌顶及广大真言章句加持摄受！
verses.meaningEn: With ambrosial consecrations and great mantra-phrases!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿密嘌 哆鼻矖罽 摩賀 曼怛囉 跋乃

verses.meaningZh: 唯愿慈悲摄受、恒常摄持拔苦！
verses.meaningEn: Draw near, sustain and embrace!

verses.meaningZh: 坚固任持行者寿命慧命不失尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Upholder and Sustainer of Life-Force!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿 臾散馱 囉抳

verses.meaningZh: 请清净、彻底清净三业尘劳！
verses.meaningEn: Cleanse, cleanse completely!

verses.meaningZh: 犹如太虚空般纤尘不染之清净尊！
verses.meaningEn: O One Pure as the Boundless Sky!
verses.tangNoteZh: 第五门第16句 · 夹注：「如虚空清净」。

verses.meaningZh: 佛顶最胜尊胜清净佛母尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Pure and Victorious Crown-Uṣṇīṣa!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鄔瑟抳 灑野 尾惹野尾秫第

verses.meaningZh: 千道光明周遍照耀警觉发起尊！
verses.meaningEn: Aroused and illumined by a thousand rays of light!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑賀娑囉囉濕茗 散祖儞帝

verses.meaningZh: 十方一切如来慈眼同所瞻视护念者！
verses.meaningEn: Beheld with grace by all Tathāgatas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩囉嚩 怛他 誐多嚩路 迦𩕳娑

verses.meaningZh: 令六度波罗蜜多功德圆满具足者！
verses.meaningEn: Fulfiller of all Six Perfections (Pāramitās)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 吒幡 囉弭哆 跛里布 羅抳

verses.meaningZh: 获一切如来真实心秘密神力加持所摄持尊！
verses.meaningEn: Empowered by the heart-blessing of all Tathāgatas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩 怛他 誐哆紇哩 娜野地瑟姹 曩地瑟耻 多

verses.meaningZh: 如来大金刚契印尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Great Mudrā (Sacred Seal)!

verses.meaningZh: 金刚坚固钩锁妙身究竟清净尊！
verses.meaningEn: Pure with an adamantine, compact Vajra-body!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉 迦野僧賀多 曩尾秫第

verses.meaningZh: 净除一切业障、报障、烦恼障及三恶道苦趣尊！
verses.meaningEn: Purifier of all karmic obstructions and evil destinies!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩羅嚩 嚩囉拏 播野訥蘖底跛哩尾秫弟

verses.meaningZh: 请回转死厄、延展清净无垢寿命！
verses.meaningEn: Turn back death and purify our life-span!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢羅 底𩕳韈囉哆 野阿 欲秫第

verses.meaningZh: 本昔三昧耶大誓愿力所加持尊！
verses.meaningEn: Empowered by the sacred Samaya pledge!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三麼野 地瑟恥 帝

verses.meaningZh: 世宝、法宝、福慧圆满大摩尼如意宝珠！
verses.meaningEn: Jewel, Jewel, Great Wish-Fulfilling Jewel!
verses.tangNoteZh: 第六门第27句 · 夹注：「世宝亦云法宝，福慧二种资粮。已上第六寿命增长门」。

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际本际周遍圆满清净尊！
verses.meaningEn: Pure as Suchness (Tathatā) and the Reality-Limit (Bhūtakoṭi)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛闥 哆部多句 致跛哩秫第

verses.meaningZh: 洞然开显本觉大菩提智清净尊！
verses.meaningEn: Pure in radiantly unfolded enlightenment!

verses.meaningZh: 殊胜、殊胜，最胜、最胜（真俗二谛圆融无碍）！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer, conquer! Triumph, triumph!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 惹野惹野尾惹野尾惹野
verses.tangNoteZh: 第七门第30句 · 夹注：「最胜最胜，即是真俗二谛法门」。

verses.meaningZh: 请忆念、忆念一切诸佛神力加持之清净本愿！
verses.meaningEn: Remember, remember the purity blessed by all Buddhas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑麼羅娑麼羅薩嚩沒 馱地瑟恥 多秫第

verses.meaningZh: 执金刚尊、金刚胎藏尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra-Holder, O Adamantine Vajra-Matrix!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日哩嚩日囉 蘖陛

verses.iast: vajraṃ bhavatu mama śarīraṃ sarvasattvānāṃ ca kāyapariśuddhiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 愿令我身与一切众生之身悉成金刚不坏体、究竟清净无染！
verses.meaningEn: May my body and the bodies of all sentient beings become like a Vajra and utterly pure!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日覽 婆嚩都麼麼 設哩覽薩羅嚩 薩怛縛 難左迦野跛哩尾秫第

verses.meaningZh: 一切六道受生皆得清净尊！愿一切如来慈悲安慰摄受于我！
verses.meaningEn: Purifier of all rebirth paths—may all Tathāgatas console and reassure me!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩 誐底跛哩秫第薩羅嚩 怛他蘖哆 室者 銘三 麼 濕 嚩 沙琰覩薩囉嚩 怛他蘖多三麼 濕嚩沙 地瑟恥 帝沒地野 沒地野 尾

verses.iast: budhya budhya bodhaya bodhaya samantapariśuddhe sarvatathāgatahṛdayādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite mahāmudre svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 自觉、自觉，觉他、觉他！普皆圆满清净尊、获一切如来心加持之大契印尊，吉祥圆成，娑嚩诃！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken, awaken! Enlighten, enlighten! O Universally Pure One, Great Seal empowered by the heart of all Tathāgatas, Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 沒地野尾沒地野冒馱野冒馱野尾沒馱尾沒馱野三滿跢跛里秫第薩羅嚩 怛他蘖多紇哩 娜野地瑟姹曩地瑟恥 多摩賀母捺哩 娑嚩 賀

titleEnglish: Secret Relic-Casket Seal Dhāraṇī of the Heart of All Tathāgatas (Complete 40 Clauses)
sutraSourceZh: 《一切如來心祕密全身舍利寶篋印陀羅尼經》(T19n1022A)
deityZh: 十方三世一切如来全身舍利宝塔
meritsAndSummaryZh: 三大咒塔核心陀罗尼之一，严格依据大藏经《T19n1022A》原典夹注「一」至「四十」共 40 句完整逐句收录。经云若书写此经置塔中，即为一切如来金刚藏窣堵波，十方诸佛常来加持。杭州雷峰塔（吴越王钱俶造八万四千铜塔）出土原刻本即为此咒。
recitationTipsZh: 本咒共 40 句，多次出现 tryadhvikānāṃ（三世）、vajra（金刚）、dhātu（法界/舍利）、mudrā（印契）等复合词，持诵时节奏宜庄重沉稳，每遇 svāhā 皆作长音收摄。

verses.meaningZh: 顶礼过去、现在、未来三世！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Those of the Three Times!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娜莫悉怛哩野 地尾 迦南

verses.meaningZh: 十方一切诸如来！
verses.meaningEn: Of all Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（法报化三身总持法音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 周遍三有世间显发最胜功德尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Supreme Manifestation throughout Existence!

verses.meaningZh: 微妙法音宣演自在尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Eloquence of Dharma-Speech!

verses.meaningZh: 摧破一切执障无碍妙智尊！
verses.meaningEn: Shattering all cognitive obstructions!

verses.meaningZh: 甘露遍流、坚固总持一切功德法财！
verses.meaningEn: Stream forth, hold fast and sustain!

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来！
verses.meaningEn: Of all Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 总持全身舍利法界藏、清净红莲华化生佛母！
verses.meaningEn: Holder of the Relic-Realm, Lotus-Born Bhagavatī!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 馱 都馱𠼝鉢蹋𤚥 婆嚩底

verses.meaningZh: 最胜尊胜妙宝尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Supreme Victory!

verses.meaningZh: 大金刚宝印尊，请忆念本昔誓愿！
verses.meaningEn: O Sacred Seal, remember Your primal vow!

verses.meaningZh: 如来无上正法宝轮！
verses.meaningEn: The Dharma-Wheel of the Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 常转法轮之金刚尊、金刚菩提道场！
verses.meaningEn: O Dharma-Wheel-Turning Vajra, Seat of Awakening!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉 靺㗚哆 娜嚩日哩 冒地滿拏

verses.meaningZh: 万德妙严饰！
verses.meaningEn: Sublime Ornament!

verses.meaningZh: 所圆满庄严者！
verses.meaningEn: Magnificently Adorned One!

verses.meaningZh: 获十方一切如来神力加持摄受者！
verses.meaningEn: Empowered by all Tathāgatas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱多 地瑟恥 諦

verses.meaningZh: 请开觉、普令众生觉悟！
verses.meaningEn: Enlighten, awaken all beings!

verses.meaningZh: 无上菩提、究竟圆觉！
verses.meaningEn: Awakening, supreme Bodhi!

verses.meaningZh: 自觉、彻底觉知实相！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken, realize directly!

verses.meaningZh: 令证无上正等正觉、究竟成佛！
verses.meaningEn: Bring about complete and perfect Enlightenment!

verses.meaningZh: 震动、摇动无始无明坚冰！
verses.meaningEn: Shake, stir!

verses.meaningZh: 普令一切执障悉皆动摇脱落！
verses.meaningEn: Let them all be shaken loose!

verses.meaningZh: 所有一切业障、报障、烦恼障！
verses.meaningEn: All karmic and cognitive obscurations!

verses.meaningZh: 远离涤尽一切恶业罪垢尊！
verses.meaningEn: Freed from all sins and transgressions!

verses.meaningZh: 速疾拔济、速疾除忧！
verses.meaningEn: Hasten, swiftly dispel!

verses.meaningZh: 永离一切忧悲苦恼尊！
verses.meaningEn: Freed from all sorrow and grief!

verses.meaningZh: 十方一切如来！
verses.meaningEn: Of all Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 真实心秘密金刚佛母尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Diamond-Heart Vajriṇī!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 紇哩 那野嚩日哩 抳

verses.meaningZh: 圆满积聚、圆满积聚福德智慧二资粮！
verses.meaningEn: Gather, amass the stores of merit and wisdom!

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来！
verses.meaningEn: Of all Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 三密总持陀罗尼宝箧契印尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Secret Dhāraṇī-Seal!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麌呬野 馱囉抳畝涅犁

verses.meaningZh: 妙觉尊、极善圆满觉智尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Awakened One, Well-Awakened One!

verses.meaningZh: 十方一切如来常住加持！
verses.meaningEn: Blessed and empowered by all Tathāgatas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱多 地瑟恥多

verses.meaningZh: 法界全身舍利宝塔藏尊，圆满成就，娑嚩诃！
verses.meaningEn: O Relic-Realm Matrix, Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 三昧耶本誓加持尊，圆满成就，娑嚩诃！
verses.meaningEn: Empowered by the Samaya Vow, Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 參摩耶 地瑟恥 帝娑嚩 訶

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来心秘密全身舍利宝箧印尊，圆满成就，娑嚩诃！
verses.meaningEn: O Heart-Relic Casket Seal of All Tathāgatas, Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩怛他櫱多紇哩 那野馱覩畝捺𠼝 娑嚩 訶

verses.iast: supratiṣṭhitastūpe tathāgatādhiṣṭhite huru huru hūṃ hūṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 极善安立妙宝塔、如来神力常住加持尊，速疾成就，吽吽，娑嚩诃！
verses.meaningEn: In the Well-Consecrated Stūpa blessed by Tathāgatas, Huru Huru Hūṃ Hūṃ Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 蘇鉢囉 底瑟恥 多薩覩 閉怛他櫱多 地瑟恥 帝戶嚕戶嚕吽吽薩嚩 訶
verses.tangNoteZh: (二合) (二合) (二合) (引) (二合) (二合) (三十七)

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！十方三世一切如来！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! All Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 无见佛顶舍利宝印、一切如来法界功德庄严加持尊！
verses.meaningEn: Crown-Relic Seals, adorned with the Dharma-Realm of all Tathāgatas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 塢瑟抳 沙馱都畝捺囉 尼薩嚩怛他櫱單娑馱都尾部使多 地瑟恥 帝

verses.meaningZh: 五智圆满，吽吽，究竟成就，娑嚩诃（四十句全本圆满）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ Svāhā!

titleZh: 大佛顶如来放光悉怛多般怛啰无上宝印十方如来清净海眼大白伞盖首楞严王陀罗尼（五会427句全本）
titleEnglish: Complete Five-Assembly Śūraṅgama / Sitātapatrā Dhāraṇī (All 427 Canonical Clauses)
sutraSourceZh: 《大佛頂如來密因修證了義諸菩薩萬行首楞嚴經》(T19n0945)
deityZh: 释迦牟尼如来无见顶相化佛 · 大白伞盖佛母 (Uṣṇīṣa-Sitātapatrā Bhagavatī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 汉传佛教每日早课首篇「咒中之王」完整五会全本！严格依据 CBETA《大佛顶首楞严经》卷七 (T19n0945.xml) 原典标号「一」至「四百二十七」，完整收录五大会全部 427 句（2,620 字一字不漏、绝无删节）：第一会毗卢真法会（第1–141句）、第二会释尊应化会（第142–163句）、第三会观音合同会（第164–272句）、第四会金刚藏折摄会（第273–329句）、第五会文殊弘传会暨十二由旬金刚结界与根本咒心（第330–427句），并逐句参校哥廷根 GRETIL 梵文原典《bsu004_u.htm》完成梵汉对读。
recitationTipsZh: 全咒五大会共 427 句：第一会至诚礼敬十方五部如来与大白伞盖佛母；第二会以「虎𤙖都嚧雍（hūṃ trūṃ）」金刚顶种子字摧伏魔怨；第三会消除十六大怖畏并剑断橛钉一切外道邪咒；第四会百千「泮吒（phaṭ）」折摄群魔；第五会净除诸恶鬼热病痛楚，结十二由旬金刚界，并以根本咒心「跢侄他 唵 阿那隶 毗舍提 鞞啰跋阇啰陀唎 槃陀槃陀儞 跋阇啰谤尼泮 虎𤙖都嚧瓮泮 莎婆诃」收摄全咒万德。

namo bhagavate nārāyaṇāya / mahāpañcamudrā namaḥ namaskṛtāya / namo bhagavate nandikeśvaramahākālāya / tripuranagaravidrāvaṇakarāya / adhimuktikakaśmīramahāśmaśānanivāsitāya / namo mātṛgaṇasahitāya / namo bhagavate tathāgatakulasya / namo bhagavate padmakulasya / namo bhagavate vajrakulasya / namo bhagavate maṇikulasya / namo bhagavate gajakulasya / namo bhagavate karmakulasya / namo bhagavate ratnakulasya / namo bhagavate kumārakulasya / namo bhagavate nāgakulasya / namo bhagavate rāgakulasya / namo bhagavate dṛḍhaśūraraṇasenapraharaṇarājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate amitābhāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate akṣobhyāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate vajradharasāgaragarjine tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyaguruvaidūryaprabharājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate amoghasiddhaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate supuṣpitasālendrarājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate padmottararājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddāya / namo bhagavate vipaśyine tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / ( Sitā 148 ) namo bhagavate śikhine tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate viśvabhuve tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate krakucchandāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate kanakamunaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate kāśyapāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate śākyamunaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate ratnacandrāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate ratnaketurājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate samantabhadrāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate vairocanāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate vikasitakamalottaragandhaketurājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / ebhyo namaskṛtvā imāṃ bhagavatīṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrānāmāparājitāṃ pratyaṅgirāṃ pravakṣyāmi / sarvakalikalahavigrahavivādapraśamanīm / sarvabhūtagrahanivāraṇīm / sarvaparavidyācchedanīm / akālamṛtyuparitrāyaṇīm / sarvasattvabandhanamokṣaṇīm / sarvaduḥsvapnanāśanīm / yakṣarākṣasagrahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarīm / caturaśītināṃ grahasahasrāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarīm / aṣṭāviṃśatīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ prasādanakarīm / sarvaśatrunivāraṇīmaṣṭānāṃ mahāgrahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarīm / ghoraduṣṭaduḥsvapnānāṃ ca vināśanakarīm / viṣaśastrāgnyudakottāraṇīm / sarvadurgatibhayottaraṇīm / yāvadaṣṭāvakālamaraṇaparitrāṇakarīm / aparājitāṃ mahāghorāṃ mahābalāṃ mahātejāṃ mahācaṇḍāṃ mahāśvetāṃ mahadīptāṃ mahāmālāṃ mahājvālāṃ mahāpāṇḍaravāsinīm / āryatārā bhṛkuṭī caiva jayā ca vijayā tathā / sarvamāravihantrī ca vajramāleti viśrutā | padmā bhāvajacinhā ca mālā caivāparājitā / vajratuṇḍī viśālī ca śāntā vaidehapūjitā | saumyarūpā mahāśvetā jvālā pāṇḍaravāsinī / āryatārā mahābalā aparā vajraśṛṅkhalā | tathā cavajrakaumārī kulaṃdarītathaiva ca / vajrahastā vajravidyā tathā kāñcanamālikā | ( Sitā 149 ) kusuṃbharatnā (radanā) caiva vairocanakulaprabhā / tathāgatakuloṣṇīṣaviśrutā vijṛmbhamānikā | vajrā kanakaprabhā locanā vajratuṇḍikā / tathā śvetā ca kamalākṣiṇī buddhalocanā | tathā vajraprabhā candrā tathā vajradharāpi ca / vajramālā mahāmāyā devī ca kanakaprabhā | sulocanātathā caivaśvetā ca kamalekṣaṇā / vinītā śāntacittā ca ātmaguṇajñā śaśiprabhā

verses.meaningZh: 归命如来、善逝、应供、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Tathāgata, Sugata, Arhat, Perfectly Awakened Buddha!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南無薩怛他蘇伽多耶阿羅訶帝三藐三菩陀寫

verses.meaningZh: 顶礼一切如来百千万亿佛顶无见顶相！
verses.meaningEn: To the Crown-Uṣṇīṣa of tens of millions of Tathāgatas and Buddhas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩怛他佛陀俱胝瑟尼釤

verses.meaningZh: 归命十方一切诸佛及诸大菩萨众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南無薩婆勃陀勃地薩跢鞞弊

verses.meaningZh: 归命七俱胝（七千万）正等正觉诸佛！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to seventy million Perfectly Awakened Buddhas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南無薩多南三藐三菩陀俱知南

verses.meaningZh: 兼及一切声闻贤圣僧伽海众！
verses.meaningEn: Together with the assemblies of Śrāvaka disciples!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世间一切应供阿罗汉圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Arhats in the world!

verses.meaningZh: 归命一切预流果（须陀洹）圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Stream-Enterers (Srotāpannas)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命一切一来果（斯陀含）圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Once-Returners (Sakṛdāgāmins)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世间一切已契入正道之阿那含等圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to those in the world who have gone rightly!

verses.meaningZh: 以及一切正行向道之四向四果圣贤僧众！
verses.meaningEn: And to those who practice rightly on the path!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三藐伽波囉底波多那喃

verses.meaningZh: 归命诸天界持法仙人众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the celestial sages (Devarṣis)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命一切成就持明咒仙众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the accomplished Vidyādhara sages!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南無悉陀耶毘地耶陀囉離瑟𧹞

verses.meaningZh: 能以威神摄伏恶毒、慈悲摄受善类之具力仙众！
verses.meaningEn: Capable of subduing evil curses and bestowing grace!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 舍波奴揭囉訶娑訶娑囉摩他喃

verses.meaningZh: 归命色界大梵天王护法尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Brahmā!

verses.meaningZh: 归命忉利天主帝释天王护法尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Indra (Śakra)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命具尊贵威德者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Venerable Lord!

verses.meaningZh: 大自在天（鲁陀罗威猛尊）！
verses.meaningEn: To Rudra (Maheśvara)!

verses.meaningZh: 乌摩天后之主！
verses.meaningEn: Lord of Umā!

verses.meaningZh: 及其一切护法眷属部众！
verses.meaningEn: Together with his retinue!

verses.meaningZh: 归命具尊贵威德者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Venerable Lord!

verses.meaningZh: 那罗延天（遍入天护法主）！
verses.meaningEn: To Nārāyaṇa!

verses.meaningZh: 执持五大海印契尊！
verses.meaningEn: Endowed with the Five Great Ocean Seals!

verses.meaningZh: 常受诸天礼敬赞叹者！
verses.meaningEn: Revered and bowed to!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊护法威神主！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed Protector!

verses.meaningZh: 大黑天神王（摩诃迦罗护法尊）！
verses.meaningEn: To Mahākāla!

verses.meaningZh: 能破三魔罗城（三有贪嗔痴城）！
verses.meaningEn: Of the Three Fortified Cities (Tripura)!

verses.meaningZh: 摧碎驱散一切魔军作大威神者！
verses.meaningEn: Who shatters and routs them completely!

verses.meaningZh: 善解脱无畏胜解心！
verses.meaningEn: Resolute in liberation!

verses.meaningZh: 住于寒林尸陀林度化群迷者！
verses.meaningEn: Dwelling in the charnel ground!

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸天母护法海众！
verses.meaningEn: By the host of Mother-Goddesses (Mātṛgaṇas)!

verses.meaningZh: 悉皆稽首归命奉事者！
verses.meaningEn: Venerated and honored!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 中央佛部（如来部族）一切圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Of the Tathāgata (Buddha) Family!

verses.meaningZh: 归命西方莲华部一切圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Lotus (Padma) Family!

verses.meaningZh: 归命东方金刚部一切圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Vajra Family!

verses.meaningZh: 归命南方宝部（摩尼部）一切圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Jewel (Maṇi) Family!

verses.meaningZh: 归命北方羯磨大象王部一切圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Sovereign Elephant (Gaja) Family!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 坚固勇猛军阵大精进尊！
verses.meaningEn: Steadfast Heroic Army!

verses.meaningZh: 击破魔怨器仗王！
verses.meaningEn: King of Subduing Weapons!

verses.meaningZh: 如来！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 归命西方极乐世界阿弥陀（无量光）尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Amitābha (Infinite Light)!

verses.meaningZh: 如来！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata!

verses.meaningZh: 应供！
verses.meaningEn: The Arhat (Worthy One)!

verses.meaningZh: 正遍知（无上正等正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: The Perfectly Awakened Buddha!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 东方妙喜世界阿閦（不动）尊！
verses.meaningEn: To Akṣobhya (the Imperturbable)!

verses.meaningZh: 如来！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata!

verses.meaningZh: 应供！
verses.meaningEn: The Arhat!

verses.meaningZh: 正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: The Perfectly Awakened Buddha!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 东方药师琉璃尊！
verses.meaningEn: Medicine Master of Lapis Lazuli!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鞞沙闍耶俱盧吠柱唎耶

verses.meaningZh: 光明王！
verses.meaningEn: King of Radiance!

verses.meaningZh: 如来！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 妙华遍敷开显！
verses.meaningEn: Fully Blossomed!

verses.meaningZh: 娑罗树王！
verses.meaningEn: Sovereign King of Śāla Trees!

verses.meaningZh: 如来！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata!

verses.meaningZh: 应供！
verses.meaningEn: The Arhat!

verses.meaningZh: 正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: The Perfectly Awakened Buddha!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 娑婆教主本师释迦牟尼尊！
verses.meaningEn: To Śākyamuni!

verses.meaningZh: 如来！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata!

verses.meaningZh: 应供！
verses.meaningEn: The Arhat!

verses.meaningZh: 正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: The Perfectly Awakened Buddha!

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One!

verses.meaningZh: 宝幢王尊！
verses.meaningEn: To Ratnaketurāja (Jewel-Banner King)!

verses.meaningZh: 如来！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata!

verses.meaningZh: 应供！
verses.meaningEn: The Arhat!

verses.meaningZh: 正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: The Perfectly Awakened Buddha!

verses.meaningZh: 我今向如上十方三宝圣众顶礼已！
verses.meaningEn: Having bowed in homage to all these!

verses.meaningZh: 宣说此世尊佛母法门！
verses.meaningEn: This Blessed Bhagavatī!

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来无见顶相佛顶尊！
verses.meaningEn: Crown-Uṣṇīṣa of All Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 清净大白伞盖遍覆护佑母！
verses.meaningEn: The White Parasol (Sitātapatrā)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命无能胜最上尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Invincible One (Aparājitā)!

verses.meaningZh: 大回遮母（能破一切恶咒邪术尊）！
verses.meaningEn: The Great Counter-Sorcery Queen (Pratyaṅgirā)!

verses.meaningZh: 于一切部多鬼魅执曜！
verses.meaningEn: All elemental spirits and planetary demons!

verses.meaningZh: 悉能调伏摄持禁制母！
verses.meaningEn: She who subdues and restrains them!

verses.meaningZh: 斩断一切外道他方恶咒母！
verses.meaningEn: She who severs all hostile spells!

verses.meaningZh: 于一切非时夭折横死厄难！
verses.meaningEn: From untimely death!

verses.meaningZh: 慈悲救护度脱母！
verses.meaningEn: She who rescues and protects!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱一切枷锁系缚母！
verses.meaningEn: Liberator from all fetters and bonds!

verses.meaningZh: 于一切恶心毒害怨魔！
verses.meaningEn: All malicious and wicked ones!

verses.meaningZh: 遮止消除一切恶梦不祥母！
verses.meaningEn: Warding off all evil nightmares!

verses.meaningZh: 于八万四千数！
verses.meaningEn: Of the eighty-four!

verses.meaningZh: 千数一切恶星执鬼众！
verses.meaningEn: Thousand planetary demons!

verses.meaningZh: 悉皆摧破坏灭母！
verses.meaningEn: She who shatters and dispels them!

verses.meaningZh: 于二十八部！
verses.meaningEn: Of the twenty-eight!

verses.meaningZh: 诸星宿神众！
verses.meaningEn: Lunar mansions (Nakṣatras)!

verses.meaningZh: 令生欢喜清净顺护母！
verses.meaningEn: She who brings harmony and favor!

verses.meaningZh: 于八大部！
verses.meaningEn: Of the eight!

verses.meaningZh: 大曜执星神众（日月五星罗睺计都）！
verses.meaningEn: Great planetary deities (Mahāgrahas)!

verses.meaningZh: 悉能摧伏凶曜灾厄母！
verses.meaningEn: She who neutralizes their afflictions!

verses.meaningZh: 遮遣一切怨家仇敌母！
verses.meaningEn: Warding off all enemies!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩婆舍都嚧儞婆囉若闍

verses.meaningZh: 消灭一切凶险恶梦恐怖母！
verses.meaningEn: Destroyer of dreadful nightmares!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 呼藍突悉乏難遮那舍尼

verses.meaningZh: 于蛊毒、刀兵器械诸难！
verses.meaningEn: From poison and weapons!

verses.meaningZh: 大火大水诸灾悉能救度出离母！
verses.meaningEn: Rescuing from fire and flood!

verses.meaningZh: 无能胜大威严尊！
verses.meaningEn: Invincible and Awesome!

verses.meaningZh: 大极忿怒威猛降魔母！
verses.meaningEn: Greatly Fierce One (Mahāpracaṇḍī)!

verses.meaningZh: 大威光炽盛照耀母！
verses.meaningEn: Greatly Blazing One!

verses.meaningZh: 大威德神力赫奕母！
verses.meaningEn: Of Great Majesty and Radiance!

verses.meaningZh: 大白净光焰遍照母！
verses.meaningEn: Blazing with Great Pure White Light!

verses.meaningZh: 具大威神力白衣观自在佛母！
verses.meaningEn: Of Great Strength, White-Robed Mother (Pāṇḍaravāsinī)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩訶跋囉槃陀囉婆悉儞

verses.meaningZh: 圣多罗菩萨（圣救度佛母）！
verses.meaningEn: Noble Tārā!

verses.meaningZh: 毗俱胝（颦眉忿怒救度）菩萨！
verses.meaningEn: Bhṛkuṭī!

verses.iast: caiva jayā ca vijayā tathā | sarvamāravihantrī ca
verses.meaningZh: 以及最胜尊胜母！
verses.meaningEn: And likewise Vijayā (Victorious Mother)!

verses.meaningZh: 号曰金刚鬘明妃！
verses.meaningEn: Called Vajramālā (Vajra-Garland)!

verses.meaningZh: 名闻遍满十方世界者！
verses.meaningEn: Renowned throughout the worlds!

verses.meaningZh: 执持清净红莲华相印母！
verses.meaningEn: Marked with the Sacred Lotus!

verses.meaningZh: 及具足金刚宝相契印母！
verses.meaningEn: And bearing the Vajra Emblem!

verses.meaningZh: 宝鬘无能胜明妃！
verses.meaningEn: Garlanded and Invincible (Aparājitā)!

verses.meaningZh: 金刚觜（摧破魔障）明妃！
verses.meaningEn: Vajratuṇḍī!

verses.meaningZh: 广大莲眼庄严母！
verses.meaningEn: And Vast-Eyed Viśālā!

verses.meaningZh: 寂静安隐、受诸天恭敬供养母！
verses.meaningEn: Peaceful One, worshipped by celestial beings!

verses.meaningZh: 慈柔满月妙色相母！
verses.meaningEn: Of Gentle Moon-like Form!

verses.meaningZh: 大白清净光明母！
verses.meaningEn: Great Pure White Goddess!

verses.meaningZh: 圣救度母（多罗尊菩萨）！
verses.meaningEn: Noble Tārā!

verses.meaningZh: 大势力无等伦尊！
verses.meaningEn: Unrivaled in Great Power!

verses.meaningZh: 以及金刚锁菩萨明妃！
verses.meaningEn: And Vajraśṛṅkhalā (Vajra-Chain)!

verses.meaningZh: 金刚童女明妃！
verses.meaningEn: Vajrakaumārī (Vajra-Maiden)!

verses.meaningZh: 持诸佛种姓母（俱蓝陀唎）！
verses.meaningEn: Kulaṃdharī (Upholder of the Buddha-Lineage)!

verses.meaningZh: 及手执金刚杵母！
verses.meaningEn: And Vajra-Handed Mother (Vajrahastā)!

verses.meaningZh: 大明咒藏紫金宝鬘母！
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā Queen Wearing a Golden Garland!

verses.meaningZh: 红莲华色摩尼宝珠母！
verses.meaningEn: Saffron-Flower Jewel Mother!

verses.meaningZh: 毗卢遮那大日佛部种姓尊！
verses.meaningEn: Of the Lineage of Vairocana!

verses.meaningZh: 如来无上顶髻光明冠母！
verses.meaningEn: Crown-Uṣṇīṣa of the Supreme Lineage!

verses.meaningZh: 频申奋迅威神开敷母！
verses.meaningEn: And Lion-Yawning Vijṛmbhamāṇī!

verses.meaningZh: 金刚紫磨真金光明母！
verses.meaningEn: Radiant as Vajra Gold!

verses.iast: locanā vajratuṇḍikā | tathā śvetā ca kamalākṣiṇī buddhalocanā | tathā vajraprabhā candrā tathā vajradharāpi ca | vajramālā mahāmāyā devī ca kanakaprabhā | sulocanātathā
verses.meaningZh: 佛眼佛母及金刚觜护法母！
verses.meaningEn: Buddhalocanā and Vajratuṇḍī!

verses.meaningZh: 白净母与清净红莲华母！
verses.meaningEn: White Goddess and Sacred Lotus!

verses.meaningZh: 莲眼清澈、皎洁月光遍照母！
verses.meaningEn: Lotus-Eyed and Moon-Radiant (Śaśiprabhā)!

verses.meaningZh: 如是等一切圣众！
verses.meaningEn: All these!

verses.meaningZh: 一切大曼荼罗金刚印契圣众！
verses.meaningEn: Hosts of Great Mudrā-Deities!

verses.meaningZh: 愿皆周遍垂慈拥护！
verses.meaningEn: May they all grant protection!

verses.meaningZh: 恒常作大加被护持！
verses.meaningEn: May they accomplish it!

verses.meaningZh: 护持于我及一切受持众生！
verses.meaningEn: For me, this practitioner!
verses.tangNoteZh: (三十七) (誦呪者至此句稱弟子某甲受持)

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（法报化三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 一切大仙圣贤海众！
verses.meaningEn: By the assembly of great sages!

verses.meaningZh: 同声赞叹称扬！
verses.meaningEn: Praised and extolled!

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来无上佛顶尊（第一会圆满）！
verses.meaningEn: Crown-Uṣṇīṣa of All Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 吽（摧破一切魔障种子字）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 特隆（金轮佛顶大威光种子字）！
verses.meaningEn: Trūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 镇伏制止一切恶魔！
verses.meaningEn: Crushing obstacles (Jambhana)!

verses.meaningZh: 吽！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 特隆！
verses.meaningEn: Trūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 凝固禁缚一切魔军令不动摇！
verses.meaningEn: Immobilizing hostile forces (Stambhana)!

verses.meaningZh: 吽！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 特隆！
verses.meaningEn: Trūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 吞啖销融一切外道恶咒邪术者！
verses.meaningEn: Devourer and neutralizer of all hostile spells!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 波羅瑟地耶三般叉拏羯囉

verses.meaningZh: 吽！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 特隆！
verses.meaningEn: Trūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 于一切暴恶药叉与罗刹鬼众！
verses.meaningEn: Of all hostile Yakṣas and Rākṣasas!

verses.meaningZh: 及一切凶星恶曜执鬼众！
verses.meaningEn: And planetary demons (Grahas)!

verses.meaningZh: 悉皆摧碎坏灭令无遗余！
verses.meaningEn: Shattering and scattering them!

verses.meaningZh: 吽！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 特隆！
verses.meaningEn: Trūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 于八万四千数！
verses.meaningEn: Of the eighty-four!

verses.meaningZh: 千数一切恶星鬼神部众！
verses.meaningEn: Thousand planetary spirits!

verses.iast: vidhvaṃsanakarī | hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭro aṣṭāviṃśatināṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ prasādanakarī | hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 悉皆摧破降伏者！
verses.meaningEn: Completely routing and dispelling them!

verses.meaningZh: 吽！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!

verses.iast: aṣṭānāṃ mahāgrahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarī | hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ ṣṭroṃ
verses.meaningZh: 特隆！
verses.meaningEn: Trūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 守护救度行者一切安隐（第二会圆满）！
verses.meaningEn: Protect and guard!

verses.meaningZh: 世尊大白伞盖佛母！
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Bhagavatī!

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来无见顶相佛顶尊！
verses.meaningEn: Crown-Uṣṇīṣa of All Tathāgatas!

verses.meaningZh: 大回遮母尊！
verses.meaningEn: Great Pratyaṅgirā!

verses.meaningZh: 具大千数威神妙相！
verses.meaningEn: Endowed with a great thousand!

verses.meaningZh: 千臂庄严、千首遍观十方尊！
verses.meaningEn: Thousand-armed, thousand-headed One!

verses.meaningZh: 百千万亿清净慧眼普照母！
verses.meaningEn: With tens of millions of wisdom-eyes!

verses.meaningZh: 金刚坚固不可坏、威光炽燃母！
verses.meaningEn: Indestructible and blazing with light!

verses.meaningZh: 威震三界自在尊！
verses.meaningEn: Resounding with mighty majesty!

verses.meaningZh: 广大金刚妙体遍摄尊！
verses.meaningEn: Sublime and Vast Vajra Sovereign!

verses.meaningZh: 统摄欲界色界无色界三有世间！
verses.meaningEn: Throughout the three worlds!

verses.meaningZh: 大曼荼罗圣坛城海会尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Sacred Maṇḍala!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 愿赐大吉祥安隐成就！
verses.meaningEn: May auspiciousness and well-being prevail!

verses.meaningZh: 于我！
verses.meaningEn: For me!

verses.meaningZh: 我今受持弟子某甲吉祥无障！
verses.meaningEn: For me, this practitioner!
verses.tangNoteZh: (七十八) (至此句準前稱名，若俗人稱弟子某甲)

verses.meaningZh: 永离王难官非怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of kings!

verses.meaningZh: 永离盗贼劫掠怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of thieves!

verses.meaningZh: 永离大火焚烧怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of fire!

verses.meaningZh: 永离大水漂溺怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of flood and water!

verses.meaningZh: 永离一切蛊毒药害怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of poison!

verses.meaningZh: 永离刀杖兵器伤害怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of weapons!

verses.meaningZh: 永离他方怨兵侵略怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of invading armies!

verses.meaningZh: 永离饥馑荒年匮乏怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of famine!

verses.meaningZh: 永离雷电霹雳冰雹怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of thunderbolts!

verses.meaningZh: 永离非时横死夭折怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of untimely death!

verses.meaningZh: 永离大地动摇崩裂陷落怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of earthquakes and chasms!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 陀囉尼部彌劍波伽波陀婆夜

verses.meaningZh: 永离流星陨石坠落怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of falling meteors!

verses.meaningZh: 永离王法刑罚牢狱怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of royal punishment!

verses.meaningZh: 永离恶龙毒蛇伤害怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of Nāgas and serpents!

verses.meaningZh: 永离闪电雷火惊怖！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of lightning!

verses.meaningZh: 永离金翅大鹏猛禽怖畏！
verses.meaningEn: From danger of Garuḍas and birds of prey!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱药叉鬼执祟恼害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Yakṣas!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱罗刹恶鬼祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Rākṣasas!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱饿鬼（薜荔多）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Pretas!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱毗舍遮（啖精气鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Piśācas!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱部多魍魉鬼众祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Bhūtas!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱鸠槃茶（冬瓜厌魅鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Kumbhāṇḍas!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱补丹那（臭饿热病鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Pūtanas!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱迦吒补丹那（奇臭鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Kaṭapūtanas!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱塞健陀（童子惊风鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Skanda spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱阿播悉摩啰（羊痫癫狂鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Apasmāra epilepsy demons!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱乌檀摩陀（狂乱失心鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Unmāda madness spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱车夜（魍魉影子鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Chāyā shadow spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 解脱醯唎婆帝（星宿恼幼鬼）祟害！
verses.meaningEn: From seizure by Revatī spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 远离食初生婴孩鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that steal newborns!

verses.meaningZh: 远离食胞胎鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that steal embryos!

verses.meaningZh: 远离饮血鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that consume blood!

verses.meaningZh: 远离食肉鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that consume flesh!

verses.meaningZh: 远离食脂膏鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that consume fat!

verses.meaningZh: 远离食骨髓鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that consume marrow!

verses.meaningZh: 远离夺人精气神采鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that drain vitality!

verses.iast: jīvitāhāriṇyāḥ, valyāhāriṇyāḥ, mālyāhāriṇyāḥ, gandhāhāriṇyāḥ, puṣpāhāriṇyāḥ, dhūpāhāriṇyāḥ, phalāhāriṇyāḥ, śasyāhāriṇyāḥ, āhutyāhariṇyāḥ, pūjāhāriṇyāḥ,
verses.meaningZh: 远离夺人寿命鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that steal life-force!

verses.meaningZh: 远离耗夺财宝福禄鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that drain wealth and vigor!

verses.meaningZh: 远离夺人气息风大鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that disturb vital breath!

verses.meaningZh: 远离食不净秽物鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits feeding on impurity!

verses.meaningZh: 远离夺人心识神志鬼女之害！
verses.meaningEn: From spirits that steal mindfulness!

verses.meaningZh: 如上所列一切恶鬼神众！
verses.meaningEn: Of all these without exception!

verses.meaningZh: 一切执曜鬼魅所造恶法！
verses.meaningEn: Of all planetary demons and spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 彼所作邪咒我今以智慧剑斩断之！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚宝橛钉伏禁制之！
verses.meaningEn: I pin them down with the Vajra-peg!

verses.meaningZh: 游行梵志外道所造邪咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by wandering ascetics!

verses.iast: vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | brahmakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā
verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.iast: śakrakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | nārāyaṇakṛtāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 荼伽男鬼与荼枳尼魅鬼所造咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by Ḍākas and Ḍākinīs!

verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.meaningZh: 大兽主天（外道摩醯首罗）！
verses.meaningEn: By Mahāpaśupati!

verses.meaningZh: 鲁陀罗部众所造咒术！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by Rudra!

verses.iast: vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | mātṛkāgaṇakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā
verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.iast: vajreṇa | kāpālikṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | śabarakṛtāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 假借那罗延天部众所造咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made in Nārāyaṇa’s name!

verses.iast: vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | pukkasakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā
verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.iast: vajreṇa | atharvaṇakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | vajrakaumārīkṛtāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 金翅鸟仙及其伴党所造咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by Garuḍas and their hosts!

verses.iast: vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | yamārikṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā
verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.iast: yamadūtakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | krūranāgakṛtāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 黑天鬼神及诸母鬼众所造咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by Mahākāla and Mātṛgaṇa spirits!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩訶迦囉摩怛唎伽拏訖唎擔

verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.meaningZh: 髑髅外道（迦波唎迦）所造邪咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by Kāpālika skull-ascetics!

verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.iast: vajreṇa | vināyakakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa
verses.meaningZh: 作胜神、作蜜神等咒师！
verses.meaningEn: Jayakara and Madhukara spirits!

verses.iast: kumārakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | caturmahārājakṛtāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 假成一切事咒术所造邪法！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by Sarvārthasādhana practitioners!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩婆囉他娑達那訖唎擔

verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.meaningZh: 四姊妹女鬼神所造咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by the Four Sisters!

verses.iast: vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | garuḍakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā
verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.meaningZh: 斗战胜神毗唎羊讫唎知！
verses.meaningEn: Bhṛṅgiriṭi!

verses.meaningZh: 难陀鸡沙啰及欢喜团主神！
verses.meaningEn: Nandikeśvara and Gaṇapati!

verses.meaningZh: 及其伴党眷属所造咒术！
verses.meaningEn: And spells made by their companions!

verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.meaningZh: 裸形外道沙门所造邪咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by naked ascetics!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 那揭那舍囉婆拏訖唎擔

verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.iast: arhatakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | avalokiteśvarakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā
verses.meaningZh: 假托阿罗汉圣名所造咒我亦斩断！
verses.meaningEn: Spells falsely made in Arhats’ names, I sever!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿羅漢訖唎擔毘陀夜闍瞋陀夜彌

verses.meaningZh: 以金刚橛钉伏之！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down!

verses.meaningZh: 假托离欲仙圣之名所造咒！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made in the name of Vītarāgas!

verses.meaningZh: 彼邪明咒我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 钉伏之！乃至假托执金刚神！
verses.meaningEn: I nail them down! Even those under Vajrapāṇi!

verses.iast: guhyakādhipatikṛtāṃ vidyāṃ cīndayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | yatra yatrakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | yena kāritāṃ tasya kṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa
verses.meaningZh: 密迹复密迹力士部众！
verses.meaningEn: Secret Guhyakas!

verses.iast: muṇḍaśravaṇakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | dūtadūtīceṭacetīkṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | sarvarṣivarakṛtāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 密迹主部下所造一切咒术！
verses.meaningEn: Spells made by lords of Guhyakas!

verses.iast: vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | sarvadevatagaṇakṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā
verses.meaningZh: 彼诸咒术我今悉皆斩断！
verses.meaningEn: I sever their spells!

verses.meaningZh: 悉以金刚橛钉伏禁制之！
verses.meaningEn: I pin them down with the Vajra-peg!

verses.iast: sarvāhitaiṣipatikṛtāṃ vidyāṃ chindayāmyasinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa | om
verses.meaningZh: 唯愿慈悲拥护于我！
verses.meaningEn: Protect me!

verses.meaningZh: 世尊大白伞盖佛母！
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Bhagavatī!

verses.meaningZh: 护念弟子某甲一切安隐（第三会圆满）！
verses.meaningEn: Protect me, this practitioner!

verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Bhagavatī!

verses.meaningZh: 清净大白伞盖尊！
verses.meaningEn: O White Parasol (Sitātapatre)!

verses.meaningZh: 我今至诚稽首礼敬于汝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage be to You!

verses.meaningZh: 具足无垢猛火与赫奕日轮！
verses.meaningEn: Blazing Fire and Radiant Sun!

verses.meaningZh: 大光明周遍照耀洞彻十方！
verses.meaningEn: Bursting forth with brilliant light!

verses.meaningZh: 广大敷展大白伞盖遍覆三界母！
verses.meaningEn: O Fully Blossomed White Parasol!

verses.meaningZh: 炽燃放光、炽燃放光！
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth, blaze forth!

verses.meaningZh: 摧裂魔障、震裂魔军！
verses.meaningEn: Split, cleave obstacles!

verses.iast: dara dara vidara vidara chinda chinda bhinda bhinda
verses.meaningZh: 粉碎、粉碎，斩断、斩断一切恶业邪障！
verses.meaningEn: Shatter, shatter! Sever, sever!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 頻陀囉頻陀囉瞋陀瞋陀

verses.meaningZh: 吽！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 吽！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒（立断魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ!

verses.iast: hūṃ hūṃ sarva ulaṅghitebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvadurlikhitebhyaḥ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 泮吒、泮吒、泮吒、泮吒（摧破四魔）！
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ Phaṭ Phaṭ Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就，娑诃！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā!

verses.meaningZh: 醯醯（金刚警觉大喝声），泮！
verses.meaningEn: He He Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 不空成就破障尊，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To the Unfailing One, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 无碍威神破障尊，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To the Unobstructed One, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 施予殊胜善愿尊，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To the Bestower of Supreme Boons, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 摧伏驱散阿修罗魔军尊，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To the Router of Asuras, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切恼人恶天障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all hostile Devas, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切毒龙障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all hostile Nāgas, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切暴恶药叉障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all hostile Yakṣas, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切寻香行鬼神障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all hostile Gandharvas, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切臭饿热鬼障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all Pūtanas, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切奇臭恶鬼障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all Kaṭapūtanas, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切邪妄越界恶障，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all malign transgressions, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: sarvaviṣebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvayogebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvālaṃbakebhyaḥ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 破除一切凶恶毒眼邪视障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all evil gazes, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩婆突澁比𠼐訖瑟帝弊泮

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切温疫疟疾壮热鬼障，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all fevers, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: sarvopasargopāyāsebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvottrāsebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvavyādhibhyaḥ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 破除一切癫痫狂乱鬼障，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all epilepsy demons, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切邪命外道沙门邪术，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all false ascetics, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切外道六师邪见咒障，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all hostile Tīrthikas, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切令心狂惑鬼魅，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all madness-inducing spirits, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: sarvapātakebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvonmādebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvavidyādharebhyaḥ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 破除一切世间邪明咒师恶法，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all hostile spell-masters, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩婆毘陀耶囉誓遮𠼐弊泮

verses.meaningZh: 于作胜神、作蜜神等部众！
verses.meaningEn: Jayakara and Madhukara!

verses.iast: jayakaramadhukarasarvārthasādhakebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvavidyācārebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvavidyārājebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvasādhakebhyo
verses.meaningZh: 一切外道求成事咒众悉破除，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against all worldly spell-accomplishers, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除一切持邪明咒行者障，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against wielders of hostile spells, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 破除四姊妹女鬼障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Against the Four Sisters, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: vajrakaumārīye vidyārājñīye phaṭ | sarvavidhnavināyakānāṃ phaṭ | paravidrāpana
verses.meaningZh: 金刚童女护法部众！
verses.meaningEn: Vajrakaumārī!

verses.iast: karāya phaṭ | sarvāsurebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvagaruḍebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvamahoragebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvamanuṣyāmanuṣyebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvamarutebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvakumbhāṇḍebhya phaṭ | vajraśṛṅkhalāya mahāpratyaṅgirāya phaṭ | sarvopasargebhyaḥ phaṭ | mahāpratyaṅgirebhyaḥ phaṭ | chinda chinda phaṭ | bhinda bhinda phaṭ | hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ | he he phaṭ | ho ho phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 大明妃威神破障，泮！
verses.meaningEn: By the Vidyā-Queens, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: amoghāya phat | apratihatāya phaṭ | varadāya phaṭ | asuravidrāyanakarāya phaṭ | sarvadevebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvanāgebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvayakṣebhyaḥ (Sitā ) phaṭ | sarvarākṣasebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvagandharvebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvakinnarebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvabhūtebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvapretebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvapiśācebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvapūtanebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvakaṭapūtanebhyaḥ phat | sarvaskandebhyaḥ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 大回遮母威神摧破群魔，泮！
verses.meaningEn: By the Great Pratyaṅgirās, Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩訶波囉丁羊乂耆唎弊泮

verses.meaningZh: 金刚锁大明王威神系缚！
verses.meaningEn: To Vajraśṛṅkhalā!

verses.meaningZh: 大回遮王摧伏魔怨，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To the King of Pratyaṅgirās, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 大黑天神王威神镇伏！
verses.meaningEn: To Mahākāla!

verses.meaningZh: 一切大天母海会部众！
verses.meaningEn: Of the Great Mother-Goddess hosts!

verses.meaningZh: 所共礼敬尊摧破魔障，泮！
verses.meaningEn: Revered by them all, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 折伏毗纽天女部众障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Vaiṣṇavī, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 折伏大梵天女部众障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Brahmāṇī, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 折伏火天女部众障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Agnī, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 折伏大黑天女部众障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Mahākālī, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 折伏死王黑杖天女障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Kāladaṇḍī, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 折伏帝释天女部众障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Aindrī, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 折伏暴怒大自在天女障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Raudrī, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: cāmuṇḍīye phaṭ | vārāhīye phat | mahāvārāhīye phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 折伏遮文茶忿怒鬼母障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Cāmuṇḍā, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: kālarātrīye phaṭ | rātrīye phaṭ | yamadāḍhīye phaṭ | kāpālīye phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 折伏黑夜神女部众障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Kālarātrī, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: mahākāpālīye phaṭ | kaumārīye phaṭ | yāmīye phaṭ | vāyave phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 折伏髑髅天女部众障难，泮！
verses.meaningEn: To Kāpālī, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: nairṛtīye phaṭ | vāruṇīye phaṭ | mārūtīye phaṭ | mahāmārutīye phaṭ | saumyāye phaṭ | aiśānīye phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 住于阿地目多寒林尸陀林中！
verses.meaningEn: Dwelling in the charnel ground!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿地目質多迦尸摩舍那

verses.meaningZh: 一切尸林神女障难悉摧破，泮（第四会圆满）！
verses.meaningEn: To the Charnel-Dwelling Spirits, Phaṭ!

verses.iast: śabarīye phaṭ | kṛṣṇaśabarīye phaṭ | yamadūtīye phaṭ | niśīdivācarebhyaḥ phaṭ | trisandhyācarebhyaḥ phaṭ | dharaṇīye
verses.meaningZh: 凡所有一切众生类！
verses.meaningEn: Whatever beings there may be!

verses.meaningZh: 有情鬼神等众！
verses.meaningEn: Among sentient beings!

verses.iast: adhimuktikakāśmīramahāśmaśānavāsinīye phaṭ | ebhyaḥ sarvabhayebhyaḥ phaṭ | sarvadoṣebhyaḥ phaṭ | om ṣṭrau bandha bandha duṣṭān rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvānāṃ svāhā | ye kecin mama sarvasattvānāṃ ca duṣṭā
verses.meaningZh: 对于我受持弟子某甲！
verses.meaningEn: Toward me, this practitioner!
verses.tangNoteZh: (三十二) (至此句依前稱弟子某人)

verses.iast: duṣṭacittā raudrā raudracittā pāpāḥ pāpacittāḥ kupitāḥ kupitacittā amitrā
verses.meaningZh: 怀抱恶意毒害心者！
verses.meaningEn: Harboring malicious thoughts!

verses.iast: amitracittā | ete mama sarvasattvānāṃ ca rakṣāṃ kurvantu jīvantu varṣaśataṃ paśyantu śaradāṃ śatam | ye kecidyakṣagrahāḥ,
verses.meaningZh: 怀抱怨敌不慈心者！
verses.meaningEn: Harboring hostile, unfriendly thoughts!

verses.meaningZh: 食人精气神采之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that consume vitality!

verses.meaningZh: 食人胞胎之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that consume embryos!

verses.meaningZh: 饮人热血之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that drink blood!

verses.meaningZh: 食人脂膏之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that consume fat!

verses.meaningZh: 食人骨髓之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that consume marrow!

verses.meaningZh: 食初生婴孩之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that steal newborns!

verses.meaningZh: 夺人寿命之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that steal life-force!

verses.meaningZh: 食祭祀供食之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that consume offerings!

verses.meaningZh: 食香气之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that feed on scents!

verses.iast: puṣpāhārāḥ, dhūpāhārāḥ, phalāhārāḥ, āhutyāhārāḥ, vittāhārāḥ, cittāhārāḥ,
verses.meaningZh: 食花朵之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that feed on flowers!

verses.meaningZh: 食果实之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that feed on fruits!

verses.meaningZh: 食五谷苗稼精气之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Spirits that feed on crops and grain!

verses.meaningZh: 怀罪恶邪念心之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Evil-minded spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 怀凶毒恼害心之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Wicked-minded spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 怀暴怒残忍心之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Fierce and wrathful spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 药叉执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Yakṣa-demons!

verses.meaningZh: 罗刹执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Rākṣasa-demons!

verses.meaningZh: 饿鬼执魅！
verses.meaningEn: Preta-ghosts!

verses.meaningZh: 毗舍遮啖精气执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Piśāca-demons!

verses.meaningZh: 部多魍魉执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Bhūta-spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 鸠槃茶厌魅执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Kumbhāṇḍa-spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 塞健陀童子惊风执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Skanda-spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 癫狂迷乱执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Unmāda madness-spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 影子魍魉执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Chāyā shadow-spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 羊痫昏厥执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Apasmāra epilepsy-spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 男魅荼伽与女魅荼枳尼执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Ḍāka and Ḍākinī spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 梨婆底恼害婴幼执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Revatī spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 如鸟怪昼夜作祟之执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Jāmaka spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 舍俱尼恶禽形执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Śakuni bird-spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 喜母难地迦执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Mātṛnandika spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 阿蓝婆依附作祟执鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Ālamba clinging spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 扼喉执手恼害之鬼！
verses.meaningEn: Kaṇṭhapāṇi spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 一日一发之虐疾热病！
verses.meaningEn: Daily fevers!

verses.meaningZh: 二日一发之虐疾热病！
verses.meaningEn: Two-day fevers!

verses.meaningZh: 三日一发之虐疾热病！
verses.meaningEn: Three-day fevers!

verses.iast: cāturthikāḥ, saptāhikāḥ, arddhamāsikāḥ, māsikāḥ, dvaimāsikāḥ, mauhūrttikāḥ,
verses.meaningZh: 四日一发之虐疾热病！
verses.meaningEn: Four-day fevers!

verses.iast: nityajvarāḥ, viṣamajvarāḥ, (Sitā ) pretajvarāḥ, piśācajvarāḥ, mānuṣajvarāḥ, amānuṣajvarāḥ,
verses.meaningZh: 常热病及寒热不调怪热病！
verses.meaningEn: Chronic fevers and irregular fevers!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 昵提什伐囉毖釤摩什伐囉

verses.meaningZh: 风大不调所致病症！
verses.meaningEn: Wind-induced ailments (Vāta)!

verses.meaningZh: 胆热黄水不调所致病症！
verses.meaningEn: Bile-induced ailments (Pitta)!

verses.meaningZh: 痰饮水大不调所致病症！
verses.meaningEn: Phlegm-induced ailments (Śleṣman)!

verses.meaningZh: 风胆痰三合并发重症！
verses.meaningEn: Combined Tridoṣa ailments!

verses.meaningZh: 如是一切温疫高热诸病悉皆消除！
verses.meaningEn: All fevers whatsoever!

verses.meaningZh: 消除一切头风剧痛！
verses.meaningEn: Headaches!

verses.meaningZh: 消除偏头痛及饮食不下恶疾！
verses.meaningEn: Migraines and loss of appetite!

verses.meaningZh: 消除一切眼目疾患！
verses.meaningEn: Eye diseases!

verses.meaningZh: 消除一切口舌唇吻疾患！
verses.meaningEn: Mouth and facial diseases!

verses.meaningZh: 消除一切心胸脏腑疾患！
verses.meaningEn: Heart diseases!

verses.meaningZh: 消除咽喉肿塞剧痛！
verses.meaningEn: Throat pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除耳内剧痛耳鸣！
verses.meaningEn: Earaches!

verses.meaningZh: 消除牙齿牙龈苦痛！
verses.meaningEn: Toothaches!

verses.meaningZh: 消除心口绞痛苦恼！
verses.meaningEn: Chest and heart pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除血脉骨节要穴剧痛！
verses.meaningEn: Pains in vital joints and points!

verses.meaningZh: 消除两胁肋骨疼痛！
verses.meaningEn: Rib and side pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除脊背酸痛疾患！
verses.meaningEn: Backaches!

verses.meaningZh: 消除腹肚肠胃绞痛！
verses.meaningEn: Abdominal pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除腰胯疼痛疾患！
verses.meaningEn: Lower back and hip pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除膀胱水道疼痛！
verses.meaningEn: Bladder pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除大腿股髀疼痛！
verses.meaningEn: Thigh pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除小腿胫腕疼痛！
verses.meaningEn: Calf and shin pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除双手臂腕疼痛！
verses.meaningEn: Hand and arm pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除双足脚掌疼痛！
verses.meaningEn: Foot pains!

verses.meaningZh: 消除周身百骸四肢五体一切苦痛！
verses.meaningEn: Pains in every limb and member of the body!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑房盎伽般囉丈伽輸藍

verses.meaningZh: 净除部多鬼与起尸鬼（毗陀罗）之祟！
verses.meaningEn: Bhūtas and Vetāla zombie-spirits!

verses.meaningZh: 净除荼枳尼魅鬼及恶热疫病！
verses.meaningEn: Ḍākinī spirits and pestilential fevers!

verses.meaningZh: 净除疥癣、瘙痒、恶癞、蜘蛛疔疮！
verses.meaningEn: Ringworm, itching sores, skin lesions, and spider-ulcers!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 陀突嚧迦建咄嚧吉知婆路多毘

verses.meaningZh: 及丹毒漫延疮、赤肿血疽诸症！
verses.meaningEn: Spreading erysipelas and red boils!

verses.meaningZh: 干枯痨瘵与惊悸恐怖诸症！
verses.meaningEn: Wasting sickness and terror!

verses.meaningZh: 一切蛊毒药咒相合之害！
verses.meaningEn: Poisonous concoctions and venomous spells!

verses.meaningZh: 猛火焚溺与大水灾患！
verses.meaningEn: Fire and flood!

verses.meaningZh: 魔障、冤仇及险道旷野厄难！
verses.meaningEn: Demons, enmity, and perilous wilderness!

verses.meaningZh: 非时横死及毒蜂蚊虻螫害！
verses.meaningEn: Untimely death and venomous wasps!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿迦囉蜜唎咄怛斂部迦

verses.meaningZh: 地栗剌吒毒虫螫伤！
verses.meaningEn: Trailāṭaka venomous insects!

verses.meaningZh: 毒蝎蜇咬之害！
verses.meaningEn: Scorpions!

verses.meaningZh: 毒蛇与獴鼬咬害！
verses.meaningEn: Venomous snakes and mongooses!

verses.meaningZh: 狮子、猛虎、黑熊、罴豹猛兽之害！
verses.meaningEn: Lions, tigers, bears, and hyenas!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 肆引伽弊揭囉唎藥叉怛囉芻

verses.meaningZh: 夺命恶兽等如是一切灾患悉令远离！
verses.meaningEn: Life-threatening beasts—all of these without exception!

verses.meaningZh: 承此清净大白伞盖！
verses.meaningEn: By the White Parasol (Sitātapatra)!

verses.meaningZh: 大金刚无上佛顶尊！
verses.meaningEn: Great Vajra-Uṣṇīṣa!

verses.meaningZh: 摩诃般赖丈耆蓝大回遮母威神力故！
verses.meaningEn: Great Mahāpratyaṅgirā!

verses.meaningZh: 乃至方圆十二由旬（约六百里）！
verses.meaningEn: Within a radius of twelve yojanas!

verses.meaningZh: 金刚道场疆界之内！
verses.meaningEn: Within that sacred perimeter!

verses.meaningZh: 我今作大明咒金刚结界！
verses.meaningEn: I establish the Vidyā-boundary!

verses.meaningZh: 我今作佛顶大威光结界！
verses.meaningEn: I establish the Radiance-boundary!

verses.meaningZh: 我今禁缚遮断一切外道他咒结界！
verses.meaningEn: I bind all hostile spells!

verses.meaningZh: 即说首楞严王根本咒心曰：
verses.meaningEn: Namely, the Ultimate Śūraṅgama Heart Mantra:

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身无见顶相总持法音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 智慧猛火遍烧烦恼尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Blazing Fire of Wisdom (Anale)!

verses.meaningZh: 最极清净皎洁无垢尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Spotless Pure One (Viśade)!

verses.meaningZh: 大勇猛执持金刚宝杵尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Heroic Wielder of the Vajra (Vīra Vajradhare)!

verses.meaningZh: 结界系缚、大结界护持母！
verses.meaningEn: Bind, O Binder of the Sacred Boundary!

verses.meaningZh: 金刚手秘密主立断一切魔障，泮！
verses.meaningEn: O Vajrapāṇi, shatter all obstacles, Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 吽、特隆（佛顶金轮种子字）、泮！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Trūṃ Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 无上菩提究竟圆满成就，莎婆诃（五大会全咒圆满）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme Awakening Perfectly Accomplished, Svāhā!

titleZh: 不空羂索毗卢遮那佛大灌顶光真言（光明真言 · 23字悉昙原典对音全本）
titleEnglish: Mantra of Unfailing Light of Mahāvairocana (Komyo Shingon)
sutraSourceZh: 《葉衣觀自在菩薩經》(T20n1100)
deityZh: 毗卢遮那如来（大日如来）
meritsAndSummaryZh: 东密与唐密最尊崇之超度、灭罪、放光加持真言，共 2 句（前附《不空羂索经》归敬礼赞句，正宗分为《T19n1002》23个悉昙梵字根本真言，绝不混拼其他独立真言）。经云若有众生造十恶五逆四重诸罪，闻此大灌顶光真言二三七遍，或以土沙加持散亡者尸骸墓上，立得光明及身，除诸罪报，莲华化生西方极乐世界。
recitationTipsZh: 第一句为毗卢遮那佛与圣观自在菩萨归敬礼赞，第二句为 23 字大灌顶光根本真言，末尾 hūṃ 字深沉宏亮、摄心观想金光遍照。

titleZh: 金刚萨埵百字明（一切如来真实摄大教王10句百字真言全本）
titleEnglish: Hundred-Syllable Purification Mantra of Vajrasattva (10 Clauses)
sutraSourceZh: 《金剛頂瑜伽他化自在天理趣會普賢修行念誦儀軌》(T20n1122)
deityZh: 金刚萨埵 / 普贤金刚手菩萨 (Vajrasattva)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 密乘忏悔业障、补阙三昧耶戒、净除身口意无始罪垢之最胜总持，全咒共 10 句、严格 100 个梵文音节（Śatākṣara，六字心咒另列独立词条，不混入百字明内）。诵持此咒能得一切如来五智灌顶，纵有失念违犯亦蒙金刚萨埵坚固摄持。
recitationTipsZh: 百字明十句句法整饬对称（dṛḍho me bhava / sutoṣyo me bhava / supoṣyo me bhava / anurakto me bhava），诵时观想心月轮上白色 Hūṃ 字放甘露光净除一切罪障。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA XML-P5 T20n1122《金剛頂瑜伽他化自在天理趣會普賢修行念誦儀軌》（唐 不空譯）
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh:
汉字咒文逐字取自 CBETA T20n1122《金剛頂瑜伽他化自在天理趣會普賢修行念誦儀軌》原文（代码比对定位，与整理稿吻合 61%）。整理稿原标出处：T18n0865 / T18n0874 / T19n0974E 《金刚顶经》(T18n0865) 暨 GRETIL 梵本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha》(sarvttsu.htm)。梵文转写逐字取自 GRETIL sarvttsu.htm（吻合 81%）。
依据梵本《一切如来真实摄经》与唐密不空译本校勘百字明纯粹 10 句 100 音节本。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚萨埵尊，请随顺守护三昧耶本誓！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Vajrasattva, guard and maintain the sacred Samaya pledge!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵嚩日囉 薩埵三麼也麼努播攞也

verses.meaningZh: 唯愿以金刚萨埵清净体性亲临安住于我！
verses.meaningEn: Stand close and abide in me in the nature of Vajrasattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日囉 薩埵底吠 努播底瑟咤

verses.meaningZh: 愿为我作坚固不坏之金刚依怙！
verses.meaningEn: Be firm and steadfast for me!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 儞哩 荼鳥 弭婆嚩

verses.meaningZh: 愿对我深生欢喜悦意摄受！
verses.meaningEn: Be well-pleased and satisfied with me!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 素覩史庾 弭婆嚩阿

verses.meaningZh: 愿令我福慧善根丰饶增长！
verses.meaningEn: Nourish and enrich me well!

verses.meaningZh: 愿对我恒常慈悲怜悯爱念不舍！
verses.meaningEn: Be lovingly compassionate toward me!

verses.meaningZh: 请赐予我世出世间一切悉地成就！
verses.meaningEn: Bestow upon me all spiritual accomplishments (Siddhis)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩悉地孕 弭鉢囉 也縒

verses.iast: sarvakarmasu ca me cittaśreyaḥ kuru hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 于一切事业中令我心常住最胜吉祥善妙，吽！
verses.meaningEn: In all actions make my mind supremely virtuous and auspicious, Hūṃ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩羯磨素左迷質多室㘑 藥矩嚕吽

verses.iast: ha ha ha ha hoḥ bhagavan sarvatathāgatavajra mā me muṃca,
verses.meaningZh: 哈哈哈哈斛（五佛五智大乐音）！世尊、一切如来金刚尊，切勿舍弃于我！
verses.meaningEn: Ha Ha Ha Ha Hoḥ! O Blessed One, Vajra of all Tathāgatas, do not abandon me!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 訶訶訶訶縠 婆誐挽薩嚩怛他孽多嚩日邏 麼冥悶左

verses.meaningZh: 愿令我成就金刚自性，大三昧耶萨埵，阿（本不生际法身种子字）！吽、癹吒（百字明圆满）！
verses.meaningEn: Make me a Vajra-holder, O Great Samaya-Being, Āḥ! Hūṃ Phaṭ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日唎 婆嚩摩訶三摩耶薩埵惡

titleZh: 普遍光明清净炽盛如意宝印心无能胜大明王大随求陀罗尼（梵本全卷445句校勘全本）
titleEnglish: Complete Mahāpratisarā-Mahāvidyārājñī Dhāraṇī (445 Clauses, Gergely Hidas Edition)
taishoNo: T20n1153 / F28n1071 (卷八) / F27n1061 / GRETIL mahpratu
translatorZh: 唐·不空三藏 译《大随求陀罗尼经》/ 辽·觉苑编《释教最上乘秘密藏陀罗尼集》卷八 / 牛津 Gergely Hidas (2012) 梵本校勘
sutraSourceZh: 《普遍光明清净炽盛如意宝印心无能胜大明王大随求陀罗尼经》(T20n1153) ·《房山石经》(F28n1071 卷八) · Hidas 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (mahpratu.htm)
deityZh: 大随求大明王菩萨 (Mahāpratisarā-Mahāvidyārājñī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 唐密、辽密与尼泊尔《五护陀罗尼（Pañcarakṣā）》之首、汉传佛教最尊崇之根本长咒全本。全卷完整收录牛津大学 Gergely Hidas 教授（2012）据剑桥与尼泊尔古贝叶经校勘之全部四大咒品共 445 句梵文原典：含第一大品 [14] 普遍光明清净炽盛大明王根本长咒（282句，对应房山石经卷八 pF28p0053a1701 全部 439 节）、第二品 [35] 护身结界随心真言（4句）、第三至四品 [45–46] 无能胜大明王心真言及秘密心印（159句），无任何删节或截断。
recitationTipsZh: 全咒共 445 句，初修可先诵第一品前 12 句毗卢遮那与三宝归敬赞，或先持随求心咒「oṃ bhara bhara saṃbhara saṃbhara indriyabalaviśodhani hūṃ hūṃ ruru cale svāhā」；专修长咒时可依每品句序逐句跟读梵音。

provenance.editionCitation: Gergely Hidas, Mahapratisara-Mahavidyarajni, The Great Amulet, Great Queen of Spells: Introduction, Critical Editions and Annotated Translation, New Delhi 2012 (Śata-Piṭaka Series 636); GRETIL mahpratu.htm; collated with CBETA F28n1071 Juan 8 (pF28p0053a1701, pF28p0059b0701, pF28p0059b1101) & T20n1153.
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh:
CBETA 全藏中未检得本条汉字咒文，现显示整理稿文字（非原典原文）。梵文转写逐字取自 GRETIL mahpratu.htm（吻合 64%）。
全量提取自 GRETIL mahpratu.htm 正文 [14]、[35]、[45]、[46] 四品陀罗尼原典并展开古写本「×2」重诵标记（如 giri 2 -> giri giri），共 445 句完整无截断。

titleZh: 十小咒之三：功德宝山神咒（5句全本）
titleEnglish: Mount of Merit-Jewels Dhāraṇī (Guṇaratnaśaila)
translatorZh: 历代课诵传本（源自《圆因往生集》暨密部赞佛功德咒）
sutraSourceZh: 《诸经日诵集要》暨《大藏全咒》
deityZh: 十方三宝暨功德宝山胜境如来
meritsAndSummaryZh: 赞叹三宝无量功德如须弥宝山，全咒共 5 句。诵持此咒能积聚广大福德资粮，临命终时消融罪业，决定蒙佛接引。
recitationTipsZh: 前三句归命佛法僧三宝，后二句 siddhe huru huru siddhūru kṛpā kṛpa 等句注意颤音 r 的轻盈连读。

provenance.editionCitation: 《诸经日诵集要》音译本暨林光明《十小咒研究》梵文构拟还原校勘本。

verses.meaningZh: 归命佛陀无上正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Buddha!

verses.meaningZh: 归命正法清净海！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Dharma!

verses.meaningZh: 归命贤圣大僧伽！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Saṃgha!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！广大悉地妙尊，速疾摄受、妙善成就！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Accomplished One, hasten, accomplish well!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 悉帝护嚧噜 悉都噜

verses.meaningZh: 以无缘大悲垂悯摄持，令一切功德宝山悉地圆满具足，娑嚩诃！
verses.meaningEn: Through boundless compassion, fulfill all spiritual accomplishments completely, Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 只利波 吉利婆 悉达哩 布嚧哩 娑嚩诃

titleZh: 十小咒之四：七俱胝佛母准提大明陀罗尼（准提神咒原典纯本）

sutraSourceZh: 《佛說七俱胝佛母准提大明陀羅尼經》(T20n1075)
deityZh: 七俱胝佛母准提菩萨 (Mahācundī Bhagavatī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 过去七俱胝（七千万）诸佛共同宣说之佛母心印，原典纯本共 2 句（七俱胝佛归敬句 + 九字准提咒心，不混入《显密圆通》外附之一字大轮咒，一字大轮咒已单列独立词条）。在家出家皆可持诵，不拣净秽，感应至速。
recitationTipsZh: cunde（准提，意为清净最胜）中 c 发舌面音，nd 为鼻音加齿塞音；cale cule cunde 音律清越庄严。

titleZh: 十小咒之五：圣无量寿决定光明王陀罗尼（GRETIL 贝叶经对照 · 5句全本）
titleEnglish: Dhāraṇī of the King of Boundless Life, Wisdom, and Well-Determined Radiance
translatorZh: 宋·西天中印土摩伽陀国三藏法师法天 奉诏译

provenance.rawSnippet: Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra evaṃ mayā śrutam / ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyāṃ viharatisma jetavane anāthapiṇḍadasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṅghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśarbhibhikṣuśataiḥ sambahulaiśca bodhisattvairmahāsattvaiḥ | tatra khalu bhagavān mañjuśrīyāṃ kumārabhūtām āmantrayate sma / asti mañjuśrīrūpariṣṭāyām aparimitāguṇasañcayo nāma lokadhātustatrāparimitāyurjñānasuviniścitatejorāja nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddha eva hi tiṣṭhati dhriyate yāpayati sattvānāṃ ca dharmaṃ deśayati | śṛṇu mañjuśrīḥ kumārabhūtā, ime jambudvipakā manuṣyā alpāyuṣkā varṣaśatāyuṣas, teṣāṃ bahunyākālamaranāni nirdiṣṭāni / ye khalu mañjuśrīḥ sattvastasyāparimitāyuṣaḥ tathāgatasya guṇavarṇaparikīrtana nāma dharmaparyāyaṃ likhiṣyanti likhāpayiṣyanti nāmadheyamātram api śroṣyanti yāvat pustakagatām api kṛtvā gṛhe dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti puṣpadhūpagandhamālyavilepanacūrṇacīvarachatradhvajaghaṇṭāpatākābhiśca samantāt pūjābhiḥ pūjāyiṣyanti te parikṣiṇāyuṣaḥ punaraiva varṣaśatāyuṣo bhaviṣyanti / ye khalu punarmañjuśrīḥ sattvastasyāparimitāyurjñānasuviniścita tejorājasya tathāgatasya nāmoṣṭottaraśataṃ śroṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti, teṣām āyurvadhayiṣyanti, ye parikṣiṇāyuṣaḥ sattvā nāmadheyaṃ śroṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti teṣām apyāyurvivardhayiṣyati | tasmāttarhi mañjuśrīdirghāyuṣkatvaṃ prārthayitukāmaḥ kulaputrā vā kuladuhitaro vā tasyāparimitāyuṣastathāgatasya nāmāṣṭottaraśataṃ śroṣyanti likhiṣyanti teṣām ime guṇānusaṃsā bhaviṣyanti | om namo bhagavate aparimitāyurjñānasuviniścitatejorājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksambuddhāya, tadyathā, om puṇyamahāpuṇya aparimitāpuṇya aparimitāyupuṇya jñānasambhāropacite, om sarvasaṃskāra pariśuddhadharmate gagaṇasamudgate svabhāvapariśuddhe mahānayāparivāre svāhā | imāṃ mañjuśrīstathāgatasya nāmoṣṭottaraśataṃ ye kecil likhiṣyanti likhāpayiṣyanti pustakagatām api kṛtvā gṛhe dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti, te parikṣīṇāyuṣaḥ punaraiva varṣaśatāyuṣo bhaviṣyanti, itaścutvā aparimitāyuṣastathāgatasya buddhakṣetre upapadyante, aparimitāyuṣaśca bhaviṣyanti aparimitāguṇasañcaye lokadhātau | om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena navanavatīnāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam | om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena caturaśītīnāṃ Buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam

verses.meaningZh: 归命世尊、无量寿智决定光明王尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, King of Boundless Life, Wisdom, and Well-Ascertained Radiance!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 捺摩巴葛瓦帝 阿巴啰密沓 阿优哩阿纳 苏必你实执沓 牒左啰宰也

verses.meaningZh: 如来、应供、无上正等正觉！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata, Arhat, Perfectly Awakened Buddha!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛塔哿达也 阿啰诃帝 三药三不达也

verses.iast: tadyathā, om puṇyamahāpuṇya aparimitāpuṇya aparimitāyupuṇya jñānasambhāropacite, om sarvasaṃskāra pariśuddhadharmate
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！一切诸行究竟清净之法性真如尊！
verses.meaningEn: Namely: Oṃ! O Dharma-Nature pure of all conditioned formations!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛你也塔 唵 萨哩巴 桑斯葛哩 叭哩述沓 达哩马帝

verses.meaningZh: 如太虚空般无碍显现、自性本来清净无垢尊！
verses.meaningEn: Arisen like the sky, pure in intrinsic nature!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 哿哿捺 萨穆得哿帝 莎巴瓦 比述帝

verses.meaningZh: 大乘妙理圆满眷属周匝围绕尊，决定延寿吉祥成就，娑喝！
verses.meaningEn: Encompassed by the retinue of the Great Way, Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 马喝捺也 叭哩瓦哩 娑喝

titleZh: 十小咒之六：药师琉璃光如来灌顶真言（GRETIL 梵本对照 · 4句全本）
titleEnglish: Medicine Buddha (Bhaiṣajyaguru) Lapis Lazuli Consecration Dhāraṇī
sutraSourceZh: 《藥師琉璃光七佛本願功德經》(T14n0451)
deityZh: 东方净琉璃世界药师琉璃光如来 (Bhaiṣajyaguru Vaiḍūryaprabhārāja)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 药师如来入「除灭一切众生苦恼」三摩地，于肉髻中放大光明所宣说之大陀罗尼，全咒共 4 句。若见病苦者，于清净食、水或药上咒一百八遍与彼服食，所有病苦悉皆消灭，无有横死，究竟得菩提。直接接入 GRETIL《bsu012_u.htm》！
recitationTipsZh: 核心咒心「oṃ bhaiṣajye bhaiṣajye mahābhaiṣajye bhaiṣajyasamudgate svāhā」中，bhaiṣajye（法药）的 bh 为浊送气唇音，ṣ 为卷舌擦音。

titleZh: 十小咒之七：观音灵感真言（5句全本）
titleEnglish: Miraculous Inspiration Mantra of Avalokiteśvara
sutraSourceZh: 《禅门日诵》暨《大藏全咒》
deityZh: 大慈大悲救苦救难观世音菩萨
meritsAndSummaryZh: 全咒共 5 句，以六字大明咒「oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ」为首，接大智（mahājñāna）、发菩提心（cittotpāda）、心寂静（cittaśayana）、离寻伺（vitarka）及世自在王归敬，专祈观音菩萨寻声救苦、消除定业灾厄。
recitationTipsZh: 本咒五句皆为纯正大乘梵语教理词汇，理解词义后持诵尤为摄心。

provenance.editionCitation: 《禅门日诵》音译底本暨林光明《十小咒研究》梵文词根考订本。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh:

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华摩尼宝珠大悲心印，吽！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Jewel in the Lotus, Hūṃ!

verses.meaningZh: 无上般若大圆镜智、发起阿耨多罗三藐三菩提心！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme Wisdom (Mahājñāna), Generation of Awakening Mind (Cittotpāda)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麻曷倪牙纳 积都特巴达

verses.meaningZh: 令心寂静安住三摩地、超离一切妄想寻伺！
verses.meaningEn: Serenity of Mind, Transcending Discursive Thought!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 积特些纳 微达哩葛

verses.meaningZh: 成就一切广大自利利他胜义、圆满人天龙神一切善愿！
verses.meaningEn: Accomplishing All Noble Aims, Fulfilling All Wishes!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 萨而斡而塔 卜哩悉塔葛 纳补啰纳

verses.iast: bhūri bhūri uttama | namo lokeśvarāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 广大复广大、最上无等伦！归命世间自在王观世音菩萨，娑诃！
verses.meaningEn: Vast, Supreme! Homage to Lokeśvara (Sovereign of the World), Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 纳卜哩 丢忒班纳 捺麻嚧吉 说啰耶 娑诃

titleZh: 十小咒之八：七佛灭罪真言（通行8句全本）
titleEnglish: Karmic-Transgression-Eradicating Dhāraṇī of the Seven Past Buddhas (8 Clauses)
translatorZh: 失译（附东晋录）《大方等陀罗尼经》卷四
sutraSourceZh: 《大方等陀罗尼经》(T21n1339) 暨《舍利弗悔过经》(T24n1492)
deityZh: 过去七佛（毗婆尸佛、尸弃佛、毗舍浮佛、拘留孙佛、拘那含牟尼佛、迦叶佛、释迦牟尼佛）
meritsAndSummaryZh: 过去七佛为愍念末法众生造作四重五逆重罪而同声宣说之灭罪真言，通行课诵共 8 句完整单列。至诚忏悔持诵，能涤除宿世罪障，心地清凉。
recitationTipsZh: 全咒八句采用重叠双声韵律（lipā lipate, kuha kuhate, traṭi traṭite, nirghārate...），犹如法水层层洗涤心垢，念诵时宜清澈舒缓。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA T21n1339《大方等陀罗尼经》卷四暨《舍利弗悔过经》(T24n1492)。

verses.meaningZh: 涤除染污、远离一切三业尘垢尊！
verses.meaningEn: O One Freed from Stain and Defilement!

verses.meaningZh: 破除覆藏、洞照深密心源尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Dispeller of Hidden Faults!

verses.meaningZh: 金刚总持、碎裂无始恶业结缚尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Upholder of Dhāraṇī Shattering Karmic Bonds!

verses.meaningZh: 彻底拔除五逆十恶罪根尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Uprooter of All Karmic Transgressions!

verses.meaningZh: 远离尘垢、清净光明遍照尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Immaculate and Stainless One!

verses.meaningZh: 安住无上大乘菩提正道尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Traveler on the Great Path of Awakening!

verses.meaningZh: 施予罪灭心安、大寂静清凉尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Bestower of Supreme Peace and Tranquility!

verses.meaningZh: 一切罪障悉皆消灭、吉祥圆满成就，莎婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: May all karmic obstacles be eradicated, Svāhā!

titleZh: 十小咒之九：拔一切业障根本得生净土陀罗尼（往生咒14句59字全本）
titleEnglish: Dhāraṇī for Uprooting All Karmic Obstacles and Rebirth in Sukhāvatī (14 Clauses)
translatorZh: 劉宋 求那跋陀羅重譯
sutraSourceZh: 《拔一切業障根本得生淨土神呪》(T12n0368)
deityZh: 西方极乐世界阿弥陀如来 (Amitābha / Amitāyus Tathāgata)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 净土宗与汉传佛教最广为传诵之阿弥陀佛根本心咒，严格按传统课诵十四句、全 59 字逐句完整单列。经云若有善男子善女人能诵此咒者，阿弥陀佛常住其顶日夜拥护，现世常得安隐，临命终时任运往生极乐国土。直接关联 CBETA《T12n0368.xml》原典。
recitationTipsZh: 全咒共 14 句 59 字，以 amṛta（无量寿不死甘露）为主轴，四次呼唤甘露现起、甘露成就、甘露神通超越、甘露广行接引，音韵如甘露流泉。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA XML-P5 T12n0368《拔一切業障根本得生淨土神呪》（劉宋 求那跋陀羅重譯）

verses.meaningZh: 归命无量光佛（阿弥陀佛）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Amitābha (Infinite Light)!

verses.meaningZh: 如来！
verses.meaningEn: The Tathāgata!

verses.meaningZh: 即说拔一切业障神咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Namely, the Dhāraṇī is as follows:

verses.meaningZh: 不死甘露法水出生尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Fountainhead of Immortal Ambrosia!

verses.meaningZh: 无量寿清净甘露！
verses.meaningEn: O Immortal Nectar (Amṛta)!

verses.meaningZh: 圆满成就一切净土善根尊！
verses.meaningEn: O Accomplisher of All Pure-Land Merits!

verses.meaningZh: 大悲不死甘露！
verses.meaningEn: O Ambrosia of Boundless Life!

verses.meaningZh: 大神通力超越三界生死尊！
verses.meaningEn: Transcendent in Miraculous Power!

verses.meaningZh: 无碍解脱甘露！
verses.meaningEn: O Liberating Ambrosia!

verses.meaningZh: 广大无畏神力奋迅！
verses.meaningEn: Striding Forth with Heroic Might!

verses.meaningZh: 周遍十方接引众生往生极乐尊！
verses.meaningEn: Guiding Sentient Beings to Sukhāvatī!

verses.meaningZh: 犹如太虚空般广大无边际！
verses.meaningEn: Vast as the Boundless Sky!

verses.meaningZh: 令佛名功德称赞遍满十方世界尊！
verses.meaningEn: Filling the Cosmos with Glorious Renown!

verses.meaningZh: 拔除一切业障、决定得生极乐净土，娑婆诃（十四句五十九字全本）！
verses.meaningEn: Uprooting all karmic obstacles for rebirth in Sukhāvatī, Svāhā!

titleZh: 十小咒之十：大吉祥天女咒 / 善女天咒（GRETIL 梵本对照 · 7句全本）
titleEnglish: Dhāraṇī of the Great Auspicious Goddess Mahāśrīdevī (Lakṣmī)
translatorZh: 唐·三藏法师义净 奉制译《金光明最胜王经·大吉祥天女增长财物品》
sutraSourceZh: 《金光明最胜王经》(T16n0665) 暨 GRETIL《Suvarṇaprabhāsasūtra / Śrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》(bsu007_u.htm)
deityZh: 大吉祥天女 / 功德天 (Mahāśrīdevī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 《十小咒》圆满结篇，出自《金光明最胜王经》，全咒共 7 句。大吉祥天女于过去宝髻如来所种诸善根，能为修行者增益衣食财宝、资具无乏，令所修福慧速得圆满。直接接入 GRETIL 梵文原典《bsu007_u.htm》！
recitationTipsZh: 前二句礼敬十方三宝与大吉祥天女，后五句宣演行愿圆满、普门照见、大慈相应之增益法印。

bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntaḥ / upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandyaikānte nyaṣīdat / śrīrapi mahādevī bhagavantamevopasaṃkrāntā / upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śatasahasraṃ pradakṣīṇīkṛtya sarvāṃśca tān sukhāvatīnivāsino bodhisattvān mahāsattvān śirasābhivandyaikānte nyaṣīdat / atha khalu bhagavānanekaśatasahasrapuṇyālaṃkṛtastathāgatakoṭiparivṛtaḥ sarvaśakrabrahmalokapālastutastavitaḥ śriyaṃ mahādevīṃ dṛṣṭā mahābrahmasvareṇāvalokiteśvaraṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvametadavocat / yaḥ kaścidavalokiteśvara rājā vā rājamātro vā bhikṣubhikṣuṇyupāsakopāsikā vā brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrā vā śriyā mahādevyā aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ vimalaprakhyaṃ nāma stotraṃ dhārayiṣyanti tasya rājñaḥ kṣatriyasya viṣaye teṣāṃ sattvānāṃ sarvabhayetyupadravā praśamiṣyanti / sarvacoradhūrtamanuṣyāmanuṣyabhayaṃ na bhaviṣyati / sarvadhanadhānyakośakoṣṭhāgāravivṛddhirbhaviṣyati / tasya ca rājñaḥ kṣatriyasya gṛhe śrīrnivasiṣyati / atha te bodhisattvā mahāsattvā evaṃ vācamabhāṣanta / sādhu sādhu ( Śmdv 95 ) bhagavan subhāṣiteyaṃ vāk / ye śriyā mahādevyā nāmadheyāni dhārayiṣyanti teṣāmapīmā guṇānuśaṃsā bhaviṣyanti / athāryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantametadavocat / kutra bhagavan śriyā mahādevyā kuśalamūlamavaropitam / bhagavānāha / gaṃgānadīvālukāsamānāṃ tathāgatānāmantikāt śriyā mahādevyā kuśalamūlamavaropitam / bhūtapūrvamavalokiteśvara atīte 'dhvani ratnasaṃbhavāyāṃ lokadhātau ratnakusumaguṇasāgaravaidūryakanakagirisuvarṇakāṃcanaprabhāsaśrīrnāma tathāgato loke udapādi / tasyāntike śriyā mahādevyā kuśalamūlamavaropitamanyeṣāṃ ca bahūnāṃ tathāgatānāmantike / imāni ca tathāgatanāmāni tasyāḥ śriyā mahādevyāḥ kuśalamūlavivṛddhisaṃpattikarāṇi / sadānubaddhānitāni śriyā mahādevyā yānīha samudḥritāni sarvapāpaharāṇi sarvakilviṣanāśanāni sarvakāryavimalīkaraṇāni dhanadhānyākarṣaṇavivṛddhikarāṇi dāridryaparicchedanakarāṇi sarvadevanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragāvarjanākarṣaṇakarāṇi sarvetyupadravopasargopāyāsasarvakalikalahavigrahavivādapraśamanakarāṇi ṣaṭpāramitāniṣpādanakarāṇi / ( Śmdv 96 ) namaḥ śrīghanāya tathāgatāya / namo ratnakusumaguṇasāgaravaiḍūryakanakagirisuvarṇakāṃcanaprabhāsaśriye tathāgatāya / namo gaṅgāsarvatīrthamukhamaṅgalaśriye tathāgatāya / namaścandanakusumatejonakṣatraprabhāsaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ samantāvabhāsavijitasaṃgrāmaśriye tathāgatāya / namo guṇasamudrāvabhāsamaṇḍalaśriye tathāgatāya / namo dhārmavikurvaṇadhvajavegaśriye tathāgatāya / namo jyotiḥsaumyagandhāvabhāsaśriye tathāgatāya / Śmdv 97 ) tathāgatāya / namo brahmaśriye tathāgatāya / namo maheśvaraśriye tathāgatāya / namaścandrasuryaśriye tathāgatāya / namo gambhīradharmaprabhārājaśriye tathāgatāya / namo
